import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import os

os.makedirs('/app/output', exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================
# COLOR PALETTE (business/technical style, muted & professional)
# ============================================================
LAYER_COLORS = {
    'source':     '#3B82F6',
    'ingestion':  '#059669',
    'bronze':     '#B45309',
    'silver':     '#64748B',
    'gold':       '#D97706',
    'consumption':'#7C3AED',
    'crosslayer': '#DC2626',
}

LAYER_LIGHT = {
    'source':     '#DBEAFE',
    'ingestion':  '#D1FAE5',
    'bronze':     '#FEF3C7',
    'silver':     '#E2E8F0',
    'gold':       '#FEF3C7',
    'consumption':'#EDE9FE',
    'crosslayer': '#FEE2E2',
}

SRC_COLORS = {
    'IoT/Streaming':     '#2563EB',
    'Enterprise Apps':   '#059669',
    'Logs/Clickstream':  '#D97706',
    'External/3rd Party':'#7C3AED',
    'Databases':         '#0891B2',
}

SRC_LIGHT = {
    'IoT/Streaming':     '#DBEAFE',
    'Enterprise Apps':   '#D1FAE5',
    'Logs/Clickstream':  '#FEF3C7',
    'External/3rd Party':'#EDE9FE',
    'Databases':         '#CFFAFE',
}

# ============================================================
# NODE DEFINITIONS
# ============================================================
# (label, layer, volume_gb, detail_line, src_category_or_None)
nodes = [
    # Source categories (0-4)
    ("IoT / Streaming",      "source",     450, "450 GB/day", "IoT/Streaming"),
    ("Enterprise Apps",      "source",     250, "250 GB/day", "Enterprise Apps"),
    ("Logs / Clickstream",   "source",     530, "530 GB/day", "Logs/Clickstream"),
    ("External / 3rd Party", "source",      95, "95 GB/day",  "External/3rd Party"),
    ("Databases",            "source",     235, "235 GB/day", "Databases"),
    # Ingestion (5-7)
    ("Batch Ingestion",      "ingestion",  310, "Spark / ADF",      None),
    ("Stream Ingestion",     "ingestion", 1015, "Kafka / EventHub",  None),
    ("CDC Connector",        "ingestion",  235, "Debezium",         None),
    # Bronze (8-12)
    ("Raw IoT Events",       "bronze",     450, "Delta / Parquet",  None),
    ("Raw Transactions",     "bronze",     300, "Delta / Parquet",  None),
    ("Raw Log Data",         "bronze",     530, "Delta / Parquet",  None),
    ("Raw External Data",    "bronze",     130, "Delta / Parquet",  None),
    ("Raw DB Snapshots",     "bronze",     185, "Delta / Parquet",  None),
    # Silver (13-17)
    ("Cleaned IoT Metrics",  "silver",     180, "Delta",            None),
    ("Unified Customer 360", "silver",      45, "Delta",            None),
    ("Sessionized Clicks",   "silver",      90, "Delta",            None),
    ("Enriched Transactions","silver",     110, "Delta",            None),
    ("Normalized Market",    "silver",      20, "Delta",            None),
    # Gold (18-22)
    ("Revenue Aggregates",   "gold",         8, "Delta",            None),
    ("Customer LTV",         "gold",         3, "Delta",            None),
    ("Anomaly Features",     "gold",        12, "Delta",            None),
    ("Product Perf KPIs",    "gold",         5, "Delta",            None),
    ("Mktg Attribution",     "gold",         4, "Delta",            None),
    # Consumption (23-28)
    ("Exec Dashboards",      "consumption",  0, "Power BI/Tableau", None),
    ("Ad-hoc SQL",           "consumption",  0, "Serverless SQL",   None),
    ("ML Training",          "consumption",  0, "MLflow/Spark ML",  None),
    ("ML Serving",           "consumption",  0, "REST API",         None),
    ("Data API",             "consumption",  0, "GraphQL/REST",     None),
    ("Reverse ETL",          "consumption",  0, "Census/Hightouch", None),
]

src_cat_list = ["IoT/Streaming", "Enterprise Apps", "Logs/Clickstream", "External/3rd Party", "Databases"]

# ============================================================
# LINK DEFINITIONS (source_idx, target_idx, volume_gb)
# ============================================================
links = [
    # Source -> Ingestion
    (0, 6, 450),   # IoT -> Stream
    (1, 5, 250),   # Enterprise -> Batch
    (2, 6, 530),   # Logs -> Stream
    (3, 5, 60),    # External -> Batch
    (3, 6, 35),    # External -> Stream
    (4, 7, 235),   # Databases -> CDC
    # Ingestion -> Bronze
    (6, 8, 450),   # Stream -> Raw IoT
    (6, 10, 530),  # Stream -> Raw Logs
    (5, 9, 300),   # Batch -> Raw Txn
    (5, 11, 95),   # Batch -> Raw Ext
    (7, 12, 185),  # CDC -> Raw DB
    (6, 11, 35),   # Stream -> Raw Ext
    # Bronze -> Silver
    (8, 13, 180),  # Raw IoT -> Cleaned IoT
    (9, 16, 110),  # Raw Txn -> Enriched Txn
    (10, 15, 90),  # Raw Logs -> Sessionized Clicks
    (9, 14, 25),   # Raw Txn -> Unified Customer
    (12, 14, 20),  # Raw DB -> Unified Customer
    (11, 17, 20),  # Raw Ext -> Normalized Market
    # Silver -> Gold
    (16, 18, 8),   # Enriched Txn -> Revenue Agg
    (14, 19, 3),   # Unified Customer -> Customer LTV
    (13, 20, 12),  # Cleaned IoT -> Anomaly Features
    (16, 21, 5),   # Enriched Txn -> Product Perf
    (15, 22, 4),   # Sessionized Clicks -> Marketing Attr
    # Gold -> Consumption
    (18, 23, 4),   # Revenue Agg -> Dashboard
    (18, 24, 4),   # Revenue Agg -> Ad-hoc
    (21, 23, 2.5), # Product Perf -> Dashboard
    (21, 27, 2.5), # Product Perf -> Data API
    (19, 23, 1),   # Customer LTV -> Dashboard
    (19, 25, 1),   # Customer LTV -> ML Train
    (19, 28, 1),   # Customer LTV -> Reverse ETL
    (22, 24, 2),   # Marketing Attr -> Ad-hoc
    (22, 28, 2),   # Marketing Attr -> Reverse ETL
    (20, 25, 6),   # Anomaly Features -> ML Train
    (20, 26, 6),   # Anomaly Features -> ML Serve
]

# ============================================================
# LAYOUT
# ============================================================
FIG_W, FIG_H = 34, 24
DPI = 120

FLOW_LEFT = 2.0
FLOW_RIGHT = 32.0
FLOW_TOP = 21.0
FLOW_BOTTOM = 8.0

NUM_LAYERS = 6
LAYER_NAMES = ["SOURCE", "INGESTION", "BRONZE", "SILVER", "GOLD", "CONSUMPTION"]
LAYER_KEYS = ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]

COL_X = np.linspace(FLOW_LEFT + 1.5, FLOW_RIGHT - 1.5, NUM_LAYERS)
NODE_WIDTH = 0.85

MAX_VOL = 1015
MAX_NODE_H = 9.5
MIN_NODE_H = 0.55

PANEL_TOP = 7.0
PANEL_BOTTOM = 0.3
TRANS_LEFT = 1.5
TRANS_RIGHT = 16.0
GOV_LEFT = 17.5
GOV_RIGHT = 32.5

# ============================================================
# CALCULATE NODE VOLUMES & POSITIONS
# ============================================================

node_vol_in = [0.0] * len(nodes)
node_vol_out = [0.0] * len(nodes)
for s, t, v in links:
    node_vol_out[s] += v
    node_vol_in[t] += v

# Effective volume for node sizing
node_effective_vol = []
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    if layer == 'consumption':
        node_effective_vol.append(max(node_vol_in[i], 7.5))
    else:
        node_effective_vol.append(max(node_vol_in[i], node_vol_out[i], vol))

node_heights = [MAX_NODE_H * v / MAX_VOL for v in node_effective_vol]
node_heights = [max(h, MIN_NODE_H) for h in node_heights]

# Group by layer
layer_nodes = {k: [] for k in LAYER_KEYS}
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    layer_nodes[layer].append(i)

# Y positions - center nodes vertically with padding
NODE_PAD = 0.18
node_y_center = [0.0] * len(nodes)

for layer_key in LAYER_KEYS:
    idxs = layer_nodes[layer_key]
    total_h = sum(node_heights[i] for i in idxs) + NODE_PAD * (len(idxs) - 1)
    y_cursor = FLOW_TOP - (FLOW_TOP - FLOW_BOTTOM - total_h) / 2
    for i in idxs:
        node_y_center[i] = y_cursor - node_heights[i] / 2
        y_cursor -= node_heights[i] + NODE_PAD

# ============================================================
# DRAWING HELPERS
# ============================================================

def make_flow_band(ax, x0, y0_top, y0_bot, x1, y1_top, y1_bot, color, alpha=0.28):
    """Draw a smooth Sankey flow band."""
    xm = (x0 + x1) / 2
    verts = [
        (x0, y0_top),
        (xm, y0_top),
        (xm, y1_top),
        (x1, y1_top),
        (x1, y1_bot),
        (xm, y1_bot),
        (xm, y0_bot),
        (x0, y0_bot),
        (x0, y0_top),
    ]
    codes = [
        Path.MOVETO,
        Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4,
        Path.LINETO,
        Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4,
        Path.CLOSEPOLY,
    ]
    path = Path(verts, codes)
    patch = mpatches.PathPatch(path, facecolor=color, edgecolor='none',
                               alpha=alpha, zorder=1, linewidth=0)
    ax.add_patch(patch)


def draw_node_box(ax, x, yc, h, w, fill_color, edge_color, label, detail, fs=8):
    """Draw a rounded-rectangle node."""
    yb = yc - h / 2
    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - w / 2, yb), w, h,
        boxstyle=mpatches.BoxStyle("Round", pad=0.06),
        facecolor=fill_color, edgecolor=edge_color, linewidth=2.2, zorder=5
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    if h >= 0.8:
        ax.text(x, yc + 0.08, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fs, fontweight='bold', color='#1E293B', zorder=6)
        if detail and h >= 1.0:
            ax.text(x, yc - 0.25, detail, ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=fs - 2, color='#475569', zorder=6, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(x, yc, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fs - 0.5, fontweight='bold', color='#1E293B', zorder=6,
                clip_on=True)

# ============================================================
# CREATE FIGURE
# ============================================================
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H), dpi=DPI, facecolor='white')

# Main flow axes
ax = fig.add_axes([0, PANEL_TOP / FIG_H, 1, 1 - PANEL_TOP / FIG_H])
ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_W)
ax.set_ylim(FLOW_BOTTOM - 1.5, FLOW_TOP + 3.5)
ax.axis('off')

# ============================================================
# TITLE
# ============================================================
ax.text(FIG_W / 2, FLOW_TOP + 3.0,
        "Data Lakehouse Architecture",

```python
       = MAX_NODE_H * (effective_vol[t] / MAX_VOL) ** POWER * (v / effective_vol[t]) ** POWER
       = MAX_NODE_H * (v / MAX_VOL) ** POWER
```

Both are equal to `MAX_NODE_H * (v / MAX_VOL) ** POWER`. The flow height is the same at both source and target. And the flow fits within the node because:

Total outgoing flow height at source = sum(MAX_NODE_H * (v / MAX_VOL) ** POWER for all outgoing flows)
= MAX_NODE_H / MAX_VOL ** POWER * sum(v ** POWER for all outgoing flows)

This is NOT necessarily equal to node_heights[s] = MAX_NODE_H * (effective_vol[s] / MAX_VOL) ** POWER.

Because sum(v^power) ≠ (sum(v))^power in general.

For example, if a node has two outgoing flows of 500 and 500 (total 1000):

- (sum(v))^0.5 = sqrt(1000) = 31.62
- 44.72 ≠ 31.62

So the total flow height at the source would be larger than the node height, causing flows to extend beyond the node boundary.

PANEL_BOT = 0.3

    node_vol_out[s] += v

for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):

def trace_source_color(node_idx, depth=0):

    """Create cubic Bezier curve points between two positions."""
    x0, y0 = p0
    x1, y1 = p1
    xm = (x0 + x1) / 2
    ctrl1 = (xm, y0)
    ctrl2 = (xm, y1)
    t = np.linspace(0, 1, n)
    x = (1-t)**3 * x0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t * ctrl1[0] + 3*(1-t)*t**2 * ctrl2[0] + t**3 * x1
    y = (1-t)**3 * y0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t * ctrl1[1] + 3*(1-t)*t**2 * ctrl2[1] + t**3 * y1
    return x, y

total_src = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'source')

def bezier_curve(p0, p1, n=30):
    """Create cubic Bezier curve points between two positions."""
    x0, y0 = p0
    x1, y1 = p1
    xm = (x0 + x1) / 2
    ctrl1 = (xm, y0)
    ctrl2 = (xm, y1)
    t = np.linspace(0, 1, n)
    x = (1-t)**3 * x0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t * ctrl1[0] + 3*(1-t)*t**2 * ctrl2[0] + t**3 * x1
    y = (1-t)**3 * y0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t * ctrl1[1] + 3*(1-t)*t**2 * ctrl2[1] + t**3 * y1
    return x, y

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
from matplotlib.collections import LineCollection
import numpy as np
import math
import os

os.makedirs('/app/output', exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================
# COLOR PALETTE
# ============================================================
LAYER_COLORS = {
    'source':     '#3B82F6',
    'ingestion':  '#059669',
    'bronze':     '#B45309',
    'silver':     '#64748B',
    'gold':       '#D97706',
    'consumption':'#7C3AED',
    'crosslayer': '#DC2626',
}

LAYER_LIGHT = {
    'source':     '#DBEAFE',
    'ingestion':  '#D1FAE5',
    'bronze':     '#FEF3C7',
    'silver':     '#E2E8F0',
    'gold':       '#FEF3C7',
    'consumption':'#EDE9FE',
}

SRC_COLORS = {
    'IoT/Streaming':     '#2563EB',
    'Enterprise Apps':   '#059669',
    'Logs/Clickstream':  '#D97706',
    'External/3rd Party':'#7C3AED',
    'Databases':         '#0891B2',
}

SRC_LIGHT = {
    'IoT/Streaming':     '#DBEAFE',
    'Enterprise Apps':   '#D1FAE5',
    'Logs/Clickstream':  '#FEF3C7',
    'External/3rd Party':'#EDE9FE',
    'Databases':         '#CFFAFE',
}

# ============================================================
# NODE DATA
# ============================================================
# (label, layer, volume_gb, detail, src_category|None)
nodes = [
    ("IoT / Streaming",      "source",     450, "450 GB/day", "IoT/Streaming"),
    ("Enterprise Apps",      "source",     250, "250 GB/day", "Enterprise Apps"),
    ("Logs / Clickstream",   "source",     530, "530 GB/day", "Logs/Clickstream"),
    ("External / 3rd Party", "source",      95, "95 GB/day",  "External/3rd Party"),
    ("Databases",            "source",     235, "235 GB/day", "Databases"),
    ("Batch Ingestion",      "ingestion",  310, "Spark / ADF",     None),
    ("Stream Ingestion",     "ingestion", 1015, "Kafka / EventHub", None),
    ("CDC Connector",        "ingestion",  235, "Debezium",        None),
    ("Raw IoT Events",       "bronze",     450, "450 GB",  None),
    ("Raw Transactions",     "bronze",     300, "300 GB",  None),
    ("Raw Log Data",         "bronze",     530, "530 GB",  None),
    ("Raw External Data",    "bronze",     130, "130 GB",  None),
    ("Raw DB Snapshots",     "bronze",     185, "185 GB",  None),
    ("Cleaned IoT Metrics",  "silver",     180, "180 GB",  None),
    ("Unified Customer 360", "silver",      45, "45 GB",   None),
    ("Sessionized Clicks",   "silver",      90, "90 GB",   None),
    ("Enriched Transactions","silver",     110, "110 GB",  None),
    ("Normalized Market",    "silver",      20, "20 GB",   None),
    ("Revenue Aggregates",   "gold",         8, "8 GB",    None),
    ("Customer LTV Scores",  "gold",         3, "3 GB",    None),
    ("Anomaly Detection",    "gold",        12, "12 GB",   None),
    ("Product Perf KPIs",    "gold",         5, "5 GB",    None),
    ("Marketing Attribution","gold",         4, "4 GB",    None),
    ("Executive Dashboards", "consumption",  0, "BI",      None),
    ("Ad-hoc SQL Analytics", "consumption",  0, "BI",      None),
    ("ML Training",          "consumption",  0, "ML",      None),
    ("ML Serving",           "consumption",  0, "ML",      None),
    ("Data API Services",    "consumption",  0, "API",     None),
    ("Reverse ETL",          "consumption",  0, "Rev ETL", None),
]

# ============================================================
# LINK DATA
# ============================================================
# (source_idx, target_idx, volume_gb)
links = [
    (0, 6, 450), (1, 5, 250), (2, 6, 530), (3, 5, 60), (3, 6, 35), (4, 7, 235),
    (6, 8, 450), (6, 10, 530), (5, 9, 300), (5, 11, 95), (7, 12, 185), (6, 11, 35),
    (8, 13, 180), (9, 16, 110), (10, 15, 90), (9, 14, 25), (12, 14, 20), (11, 17, 20),
    (16, 18, 8), (14, 19, 3), (13, 20, 12), (16, 21, 5), (15, 22, 4),
    (18, 23, 4), (18, 24, 4), (21, 23, 2.5), (21, 27, 2.5),
    (19, 23, 1), (19, 25, 1), (19, 28, 1),
    (22, 24, 2), (22, 28, 2), (20, 25, 6), (20, 26, 6),
]

# ============================================================
# LAYOUT PARAMETERS
# ============================================================
FIG_W, FIG_H = 36, 26
DPI = 110

FLOW_TOP = 22.5
FLOW_BOTTOM = 8.5
FLOW_LEFT = 2.5
FLOW_RIGHT = 33.5

LAYER_NAMES = ["SOURCE", "INGESTION", "BRONZE", "SILVER", "GOLD", "CONSUMPTION"]
LAYER_KEYS = ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]
NUM_LAYERS = 6

COL_X = np.linspace(FLOW_LEFT + 1.2, FLOW_RIGHT - 1.2, NUM_LAYERS)
NODE_W = 1.1

# Power-scaled node heights for visual compression
POWER = 0.45
MAX_VOL = 1015
MAX_NODE_H = 8.5
MIN_NODE_H = 0.85
NODE_PAD = 0.2

PANEL_TOP = 7.5
PANEL_BOT = 0.3

# ============================================================
# COMPUTE VOLUMES
# ============================================================
node_vol_in = [0.0] * len(nodes)
node_vol_out = [0.0] * len(nodes)
for s, t, v in links:
    node_vol_out[s] += v
    node_vol_in[t] += v

node_effective_vol = []
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    if layer == 'consumption':
        node_effective_vol.append(max(node_vol_in[i], 7.5))
    else:
        node_effective_vol.append(max(node_vol_in[i], node_vol_out[i], vol, 1))

# Power-scaled heights
node_heights = []
for i in range(len(nodes)):
    h = MAX_NODE_H * (node_effective_vol[i] / MAX_VOL) ** POWER
    node_heights.append(max(h, MIN_NODE_H))

# ============================================================
# NODE POSITIONS
# ============================================================
layer_nodes = {k: [] for k in LAYER_KEYS}
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    layer_nodes[layer].append(i)

node_y_center = [0.0] * len(nodes)

for layer_key in LAYER_KEYS:
    idxs = layer_nodes[layer_key]
    total_h = sum(node_heights[i] for i in idxs) + NODE_PAD * (len(idxs) - 1)
    y_cursor = FLOW_TOP - (FLOW_TOP - FLOW_BOTTOM - total_h) / 2
    for i in idxs:
        node_y_center[i] = y_cursor - node_heights[i] / 2
        y_cursor -= node_heights[i] + NODE_PAD

# ============================================================
# TRACE SOURCE COLORS THROUGH PIPELINE
# ============================================================
def trace_source_color(node_idx, depth=0):
    if depth > 10:
        return LAYER_COLORS[nodes[node_idx][1]]
    if nodes[node_idx][1] == 'source' and nodes[node_idx][4]:
        return SRC_COLORS.get(nodes[node_idx][4], LAYER_COLORS['source'])
    incoming = [(s, v) for s, t, v in links if t == node_idx]
    if not incoming:
        return LAYER_COLORS[nodes[node_idx][1]]
    biggest_src = max(incoming, key=lambda x: x[1])[0]
    return trace_source_color(biggest_src, depth + 1)

node_flow_color = [trace_source_color(i) for i in range(len(nodes))]

# ============================================================
# CREATE FIGURE
# ============================================================
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H), dpi=DPI, facecolor='white')

ax = fig.add_axes([0, PANEL_TOP / FIG_H, 1, 1 - PANEL_TOP / FIG_H])
ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_W)
ax.set_ylim(FLOW_BOTTOM - 1.5, FLOW_TOP + 4.0)
ax.axis('off')

# ============================================================
# TITLE
# ============================================================
ax.text(FIG_W / 2, FLOW_TOP + 3.5,
        "Data Lakehouse Architecture",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=24, fontweight='bold', color='#0F172A')
ax.text(FIG_W / 2, FLOW_TOP + 2.6,
        "End-to-End Pipeline & Data Flow  |  Medallion Architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold)",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=13, color='#475569')

# ============================================================
# LAYER HEADERS WITH MEDALLION ICONS
# ============================================================
for i, (lname, lkey) in enumerate(zip(LAYER_NAMES, LAYER_KEYS)):
    x = COL_X[i]
    c = LAYER_COLORS[lkey]
    lc = LAYER_LIGHT[lkey]
    ax.text(x, FLOW_TOP + 1.4, lname, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color=c,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.35', facecolor=lc,
                      edgecolor=c, linewidth=2.5, alpha=0.9))

# ============================================================
# DRAW FLOW LINES (Bezier curves with variable width)
# ============================================================
def bezier_curve(p0, p1, n=30):
    """Create cubic Bezier curve points between two positions."""
    x0, y0 = p0
    x1, y1 = p1
    xm = (x0 + x1) / 2
    ctrl1 = (xm, y0)
    ctrl2 = (xm, y1)
    t = np.linspace(0, 1, n)
    x = (1-t)**3 * x0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t * ctrl1[0] + 3*(1-t)*t**2 * ctrl2[0] + t**3 * x1
    y = (1-t)**3 * y0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t * ctrl1[1] + 3*(1-t)*t**2 * ctrl2[1] + t**3 * y1
    return x, y

# Sort links by volume (draw smallest first so largest are on top)
sorted_links = sorted(links, key=lambda l: l[2])

for s, t, v in sorted_links:
    src_layer = nodes[s][1]
    tgt_layer = nodes[t][1]

    x_src = COL_X[LAYER_KEYS.index(src_layer)] + NODE_W / 2
    x_tgt = COL_X[LAYER_KEYS.index(tgt_layer)] - NODE_W / 2
    y_src = node_y_center[s]
    y_tgt = node_y_center[t]

    # Line width proportional to volume (power scale for visual compression)
    lw = 0.6 + 7.5 * (v / MAX_VOL) ** 0.45

    # Color from source category trace
    flow_color = node_flow_color[s]

    # Draw curve
    bx, by = bezier_curve((x_src, y_src), (x_tgt, y_tgt), n=40)
    ax.plot(bx, by, color=flow_color, linewidth=lw, alpha=0.35, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=1)

    # Small arrowhead at target
    dx = bx[-1] - bx[-3]
    dy = by[-1] - by[-3]
    arr_len = 0.25
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x_tgt, y_tgt),
                xytext=(x_tgt - arr_len * dx / max(abs(dx), 0.01),
                        y_tgt - arr_len * dy / max(abs(dy), 0.01)),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=flow_color, lw=min(lw * 0.6, 3)),
                zorder=2)

# ============================================================
# DRAW NODES
# ============================================================
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    col_idx = LAYER_KEYS.index(layer)
    x = COL_X[col_idx]
    yc = node_y_center[i]
    h = node_heights[i]

    if layer == 'source' and cat:
        edge_c = SRC_COLORS.get(cat, LAYER_COLORS[layer])
        fill_c = SRC_LIGHT.get(cat, LAYER_LIGHT[layer])
    else:
        edge_c = LAYER_COLORS[layer]
        fill_c = LAYER_LIGHT[layer]

    yb = yc - h / 2
    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - NODE_W / 2, yb), NODE_W, h,
        boxstyle=mpatches.BoxStyle("Round", pad=0.06),
        facecolor=fill_c, edgecolor=edge_c, linewidth=2.5, zorder=5
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    # Node text
    if h >= 1.2:
        ax.text(x, yc + 0.12, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color='#1E293B', zorder=6)
        if detail:
            ax.text(x, yc - 0.25, detail, ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=7, color='#475569', zorder=6, style='italic')
    elif h >= 0.85:
        ax.text(x, yc + 0.08, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', color='#1E293B', zorder=6)
        ax.text(x, yc - 0.18, detail, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=6, color='#475569', zorder=6, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(x, yc, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold', color='#1E293B', zorder=6,
                clip_on=True)

# ============================================================
# CONSUMPTION INCOMING VOLUME ANNOTATIONS
# ============================================================
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    if layer == 'consumption':
        col_idx = LAYER_KEYS.index(layer)
        x = COL_X[col_idx] + NODE_W / 2 + 0.12
        y = node_y_center[i]
        incoming_vol = sum(v for s, t, v in links if t == i)
        if incoming_vol > 0:
            ax.text(x, y, f"  {incoming_vol:.0f} GB", ha='left', va='center',
                    fontsize=6.5, color='#64748B', zorder=7)

# ============================================================
# VOLUME REDUCTION SUMMARY
# ============================================================
total_src = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'source')
total_brz = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'bronze')
total_slv = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'silver')
total_gld = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'gold')
pct = (1 - total_gld / total_src) * 100

ax.text(FIG_W / 2, FLOW_BOTTOM - 0.5,
        f"Daily Volume:  {total_src:,} GB (Source)  →  {total_brz:,} GB (Bronze)  →  "
        f"{total_slv:,} GB (Silver)  →  {total_gld:,} GB (Gold)   —   "
        f"{pct:.1f}% total reduction from raw to refined",
        ha='center', va='top', fontsize=10, color='#334155',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor='#F1F5F9',
                  edgecolor='#94A3B8', linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.9))

# ============================================================
# GOVERNANCE VERTICAL STRIP (cross-layer overlay)
# ============================================================
# Subtle dashed red vertical bar on far right to indicate governance spans all layers
gov_x = FLOW_RIGHT + 0.5
for yy in np.linspace(FLOW_BOTTOM, FLOW_TOP, 25):
    ax.plot([gov_x, gov_x], [yy, yy + (FLOW_TOP - FLOW_BOTTOM) / 50],
            color='#DC2626', linewidth=2.0, alpha=0.35, zorder=0)

ax.text(gov_x, FLOW_TOP + 1.4, "GOV", ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='#DC2626',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='#FEE2E2',
                  edgecolor='#DC2626', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.9))

# Small governance labels at each layer
gov_labels = {
    'ingestion': 'Schema Val.\nQuality Gate',
    'bronze': 'Audit Log\nPII Detect',
    'silver': 'Encryption\nLineage\nRow Security',
    'gold': 'RBAC\nCertification\nUsage Track',
    'consumption': 'Auth\nRate Limit',
}
for layer_key, glabel in gov_labels.items():
    col_idx = LAYER_KEYS.index(layer_key)
    x = COL_X[col_idx]
    # Find y-center of layer
    idxs = layer_nodes[layer_key]
    y_top = node_y_center[idxs[0]] + node_heights[idxs[0]] / 2
    y_bot = node_y_center[idxs[-1]] - node_heights[idxs[-1]] / 2
    y_mid = (y_top + y_bot) / 2
    # Draw a small bracket on the left
    bx = x - NODE_W / 2 - 0.15
    ax.plot([bx - 0.3, bx - 0.3], [y_top, y_bot], color='#DC2626', linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.4, zorder=0)
    ax.text(bx - 0.4, y_mid, glabel, ha='right', va='center',
            fontsize=5.5, color='#DC2626', alpha=0.6, zorder=0)

# ============================================================
# SOURCE CATEGORY LEGEND
# ============================================================
leg_x = FLOW_LEFT + 0.3
leg_y = FLOW_BOTTOM - 1.2
ax.text(leg_x, leg_y, "Source Categories:", fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='#475569')
for ci, (cat_name, cat_color) in enumerate(SRC_COLORS.items()):
    xoff = leg_x + ci * 2.8
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (xoff, leg_y - 0.5), 0.3, 0.3,

        edgecolor=cat_color, linewidth=1.5, zorder=5))
    ax.text(xoff + 0.4, leg_y - 0.35, cat_name, fontsize=6.5, color='#334155', va='center')

# ============================================================
# TRANSFORMATION SUMMARY PANEL (bottom-left)
# ============================================================
ax_t = fig.add_axes([1.5 / FIG_W, PANEL_BOT / FIG_H,
                      14.5 / FIG_W, (PANEL_TOP - PANEL_BOT - 0.3) / FIG_H])

    ('Bronze', 'Schema-on-Read', 10, 'low', LAYER_COLORS['bronze']),

y_pos = list(range(len(trans_data)))
labels_t = [f"{d[0]}: {d[1]}" for d in trans_data]
widths = [d[2] for d in trans_data]
fills = [comp_fill[d[3]] for d in trans_data]
edges = [comp_edge[d[3]] for d in trans_data]

ax_t.barh(y_pos, widths, color=fills, edgecolor=edges,

for yi, w in zip(y_pos, widths):

links = [
    (0, 6, 450), (1, 5, 250), (2, 6, 530), (3, 5, 60), (3, 6, 35), (4, 7, 235),
    (6, 8, 450), (6, 10, 530), (5, 9, 300), (5, 11, 95), (7, 12, 185), (6, 11, 35),
    (8, 13, 180), (9, 16, 110), (10, 15, 90), (9, 14, 25), (12, 14, 20), (11, 17, 20),
    (16, 18, 8), (14, 19, 3), (13, 20, 12), (16, 21, 5), (15, 22, 4),
    (18, 23, 4), (18, 24, 4), (21, 23, 2.5), (21, 27, 2.5),
    (19, 23, 1), (19, 25, 1), (19, 28, 1),
    (22, 24, 2), (22, 28, 2), (20, 25, 6), (20, 26, 6),
]

# ============================================================
# LAYOUT PARAMETERS
# ============================================================
FIG_W, FIG_H = 36, 26
DPI = 110

FLOW_TOP = 22.5
FLOW_BOTTOM = 8.5
FLOW_LEFT = 2.5
FLOW_RIGHT = 33.5

LAYER_NAMES = ["SOURCE", "INGESTION", "BRONZE", "SILVER", "GOLD", "CONSUMPTION"]
LAYER_KEYS = ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]
NUM_LAYERS = 6

COL_X = np.linspace(FLOW_LEFT + 1.2, FLOW_RIGHT - 1.2, NUM_LAYERS)
NODE_W = 1.1

# Power-scaled node heights for visual compression
POWER = 0.45
MAX_VOL = 1015
MAX_NODE_H = 8.5
MIN_NODE_H = 0.85
NODE_PAD = 0.2

PANEL_TOP = 7.5
PANEL_BOT = 0.3

# ============================================================
# COMPUTE VOLUMES
# ============================================================
node_vol_in = [0.0] * len(nodes)
node_vol_out = [0.0] * len(nodes)
for s, t, v in links:
    node_vol_out[s] += v
    node_vol_in[t] += v

node_effective_vol = []
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    if layer == 'consumption':
        node_effective_vol.append(max(node_vol_in[i], 7.5))
    else:
        node_effective_vol.append(max(node_vol_in[i], node_vol_out[i], vol, 1))

# Power-scaled heights
node_heights = []
for i in range(len(nodes)):
    h = MAX_NODE_H * (node_effective_vol[i] / MAX_VOL) ** POWER
    node_heights.append(max(h, MIN_NODE_H))

# ============================================================
# NODE POSITIONS
# ============================================================
layer_nodes = {k: [] for k in LAYER_KEYS}
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    layer_nodes[layer].append(i)

node_y_center = [0.0] * len(nodes)

for layer_key in LAYER_KEYS:
    idxs = layer_nodes[layer_key]
    total_h = sum(node_heights[i] for i in idxs) + NODE_PAD * (len(idxs) - 1)
    y_cursor = FLOW_TOP - (FLOW_TOP - FLOW_BOTTOM - total_h) / 2
    for i in idxs:
        node_y_center[i] = y_cursor - node_heights[i] / 2
        y_cursor -= node_heights[i] + NODE_PAD

# ============================================================
# TRACE SOURCE COLORS THROUGH PIPELINE
# ============================================================
def trace_source_color(node_idx, depth=0):
    if depth > 10:
        return LAYER_COLORS[nodes[node_idx][1]]
    if nodes[node_idx][1] == 'source' and nodes[node_idx][4]:
        return SRC_COLORS.get(nodes[node_idx][4], LAYER_COLORS['source'])
    incoming = [(s, v) for s, t, v in links if t == node_idx]
    if not incoming:
        return LAYER_COLORS[nodes[node_idx][1]]
    biggest_src = max(incoming, key=lambda x: x[1])[0]
    return trace_source_color(biggest_src, depth + 1)

node_flow_color = [trace_source_color(i) for i in range(len(nodes))]

# ============================================================
# CREATE FIGURE
# ============================================================
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H), dpi=DPI, facecolor='white')

ax = fig.add_axes([0, PANEL_TOP / FIG_H, 1, 1 - PANEL_TOP / FIG_H])
ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_W)
ax.set_ylim(FLOW_BOTTOM - 1.5, FLOW_TOP + 4.0)
ax.axis('off')

# ============================================================
# TITLE
# ============================================================
ax.text(FIG_W / 2, FLOW_TOP + 3.5,
        "Data Lakehouse Architecture",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=24, fontweight='bold', color='#0F172A')
ax.text(FIG_W / 2, FLOW_TOP + 2.6,
        "End-to-End Pipeline & Data Flow  |  Medallion Architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold)",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=13, color='#475569')

# ============================================================
# LAYER HEADERS WITH MEDALLION ICONS
# ============================================================
for i, (lname, lkey) in enumerate(zip(LAYER_NAMES, LAYER_KEYS)):
    x = COL_X[i]
    c = LAYER_COLORS[lkey]
    lc = LAYER_LIGHT[lkey]
    ax.text(x, FLOW_TOP + 1.4, lname, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color=c,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.35', facecolor=lc,
                      edgecolor=c, linewidth=2.5, alpha=0.9))

# ============================================================
# DRAW FLOW LINES (Bezier curves with variable width)
# ============================================================
def bezier_curve(p0, p1, n=30):
    """Create cubic Bezier curve points between two positions."""
    x0, y0 = p0
    x1, y1 = p1
    xm = (x0 + x1) / 2
    ctrl1 = (xm, y0)
    ctrl2 = (xm, y1)
    t = np.linspace(0, 1, n)
    x = (1-t)**3 * x0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t * ctrl1[0] + 3*(1-t)*t**2 * ctrl2[0] + t**3 * x1
    y = (1-t)**3 * y0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t * ctrl1[1] + 3*(1-t)*t**2 * ctrl2[1] + t**3 * y1
    return x, y

# Sort links by volume (draw smallest first so largest are on top)
sorted_links = sorted(links, key=lambda l: l[2])

for s, t, v in sorted_links:
    src_layer = nodes[s][1]
    tgt_layer = nodes[t][1]

    x_src = COL_X[LAYER_KEYS.index(src_layer)] + NODE_W / 2
    x_tgt = COL_X[LAYER_KEYS.index(tgt_layer)] - NODE_W / 2
    y_src = node_y_center[s]
    y_tgt = node_y_center[t]

    # Line width proportional to volume (power scale for visual compression)
    lw = 0.6 + 7.5 * (v / MAX_VOL) ** 0.45

    # Color from source category trace
    flow_color = node_flow_color[s]

    # Draw curve
    bx, by = bezier_curve((x_src, y_src), (x_tgt, y_tgt), n=40)
    ax.plot(bx, by, color=flow_color, linewidth=lw, alpha=0.35, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=1)

    # Small arrowhead at target
    dx = bx[-1] - bx[-3]
    dy = by[-1] - by[-3]
    arr_len = 0.25
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x_tgt, y_tgt),
                xytext=(x_tgt - arr_len * dx / max(abs(dx), 0.01),
                        y_tgt - arr_len * dy / max(abs(dy), 0.01)),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=flow_color, lw=min(lw * 0.6, 3)),
                zorder=2)

# ============================================================
# DRAW NODES
# ============================================================
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    col_idx = LAYER_KEYS.index(layer)
    x = COL_X[col_idx]
    yc = node_y_center[i]
    h = node_heights[i]

    if layer == 'source' and cat:
        edge_c = SRC_COLORS.get(cat, LAYER_COLORS[layer])
        fill_c = SRC_LIGHT.get(cat, LAYER_LIGHT[layer])
    else:
        edge_c = LAYER_COLORS[layer]
        fill_c = LAYER_LIGHT[layer]

    yb = yc - h / 2
    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - NODE_W / 2, yb), NODE_W, h,
        boxstyle=mpatches.BoxStyle("Round", pad=0.06),
        facecolor=fill_c, edgecolor=edge_c, linewidth=2.5, zorder=5
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    # Node text
    if h >= 1.2:
        ax.text(x, yc + 0.12, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color='#1E293B', zorder=6)
        if detail:
            ax.text(x, yc - 0.25, detail, ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=7, color='#475569', zorder=6, style='italic')
    elif h >= 0.85:
        ax.text(x, yc + 0.08, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', color='#1E293B', zorder=6)
        ax.text(x, yc - 0.18, detail, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=6, color='#475569', zorder=6, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(x, yc, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold', color='#1E293B', zorder=6,
                clip_on=True)

# ============================================================
# CONSUMPTION INCOMING VOLUME ANNOTATIONS
# ============================================================
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    if layer == 'consumption':
        col_idx = LAYER_KEYS.index(layer)
        x = COL_X[col_idx] + NODE_W / 2 + 0.12
        y = node_y_center[i]
        incoming_vol = sum(v for s, t, v in links if t == i)
        if incoming_vol > 0:
            ax.text(x, y, f"  {incoming_vol:.0f} GB", ha='left', va='center',
                    fontsize=6.5, color='#64748B', zorder=7)

# ============================================================
# VOLUME REDUCTION SUMMARY
# ============================================================
total_src = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'source')
total_brz = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'bronze')
total_slv = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'silver')
total_gld = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'gold')
pct = (1 - total_gld / total_src) * 100

ax.text(FIG_W / 2, FLOW_BOTTOM - 0.5,
        f"Daily Volume:  {total_src:,} GB (Source)  →  {total_brz:,} GB (Bronze)  →  "
        f"{total_slv:,} GB (Silver)  →  {total_gld:,} GB (Gold)   —   "
        f"{pct:.1f}% total reduction from raw to refined",

        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor='#F1F5F9',
                  edgecolor='#94A3B8', linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.9))

# ============================================================

# Subtle dashed red vertical bar on far right to indicate governance spans all layers
gov_x = FLOW_RIGHT + 0.5
for yy in np.linspace(FLOW_BOTTOM, FLOW_TOP, 25):
    ax.plot([gov_x, gov_x], [yy, yy + (FLOW_TOP - FLOW_BOTTOM) / 50],
            color='#DC2626', linewidth=2.0, alpha=0.35, zorder=0)

ax.text(gov_x, FLOW_TOP + 1.4, "GOV", ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='#DC2626',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='#FEE2E2',
                  edgecolor='#DC2626', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.9))

# Small governance labels at each layer
gov_labels = {
    'ingestion': 'Schema Val.\nQuality Gate',
    'bronze': 'Audit Log\nPII Detect',
    'silver': 'Encryption\nLineage\nRow Security',
    'gold': 'RBAC\nCertification\nUsage Track',
    'consumption': 'Auth\nRate Limit',
}
for layer_key, glabel in gov_labels.items():
    col_idx = LAYER_KEYS.index(layer_key)

    ax.text(bx - 0.4, y_mid, glabel, ha='right', va='center',

# SOURCE CATEGORY LEGEND

leg_x = FLOW_LEFT + 0.3

for ci, (cat_name, cat_color) in enumerate(SRC_COLORS.items()):

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
from matplotlib.collections import LineCollection
import numpy as np
import math
import os

os.makedirs('/app/output', exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================
# COLOR PALETTE
# ============================================================
LAYER_COLORS = {
    'source':     '#3B82F6',
    'ingestion':  '#059669',
    'bronze':     '#B45309',
    'silver':     '#64748B',
    'gold':       '#D97706',
    'consumption':'#7C3AED',
    'crosslayer': '#DC2626',
}

LAYER_LIGHT = {
    'source':     '#DBEAFE',
    'ingestion':  '#D1FAE5',
    'bronze':     '#FEF3C7',
    'silver':     '#E2E8F0',
    'gold':       '#FEF3C7',
    'consumption':'#EDE9FE',
}

SRC_COLORS = {
    'IoT/Streaming':     '#2563EB',
    'Enterprise Apps':   '#059669',
    'Logs/Clickstream':  '#D97706',
    'External/3rd Party':'#7C3AED',
    'Databases':         '#0891B2',
}

SRC_LIGHT = {
    'IoT/Streaming':     '#DBEAFE',
    'Enterprise Apps':   '#D1FAE5',
    'Logs/Clickstream':  '#FEF3C7',
    'External/3rd Party':'#EDE9FE',
    'Databases':         '#CFFAFE',
}

# ============================================================
# NODE DATA
# ============================================================
# (label, layer, volume_gb, detail, src_category|None)
nodes = [
    ("IoT / Streaming",      "source",     450, "450 GB/day", "IoT/Streaming"),
    ("Enterprise Apps",      "source",     250, "250 GB/day", "Enterprise Apps"),
    ("Logs / Clickstream",   "source",     530, "530 GB/day", "Logs/Clickstream"),
    ("External / 3rd Party", "source",      95, "95 GB/day",  "External/3rd Party"),
    ("Databases",            "source",     235, "235 GB/day", "Databases"),
    ("Batch Ingestion",      "ingestion",  310, "Spark / ADF",     None),
    ("Stream Ingestion",     "ingestion", 1015, "Kafka / EventHub", None),
    ("CDC Connector",        "ingestion",  235, "Debezium",        None),
    ("Raw IoT Events",       "bronze",     450, "450 GB",  None),
    ("Raw Transactions",     "bronze",     300, "300 GB",  None),
    ("Raw Log Data",         "bronze",     530, "530 GB",  None),
    ("Raw External Data",    "bronze",     130, "130 GB",  None),
    ("Raw DB Snapshots",     "bronze",     185, "185 GB",  None),
    ("Cleaned IoT Metrics",  "silver",     180, "180 GB",  None),
    ("Unified Customer 360", "silver",      45, "45 GB",   None),
    ("Sessionized Clicks",   "silver",      90, "90 GB",   None),
    ("Enriched Transactions","silver",     110, "110 GB",  None),
    ("Normalized Market",    "silver",      20, "20 GB",   None),
    ("Revenue Aggregates",   "gold",         8, "8 GB",    None),
    ("Customer LTV Scores",  "gold",         3, "3 GB",    None),
    ("Anomaly Detection",    "gold",        12, "12 GB",   None),
    ("Product Perf KPIs",    "gold",         5, "5 GB",    None),
    ("Marketing Attribution","gold",         4, "4 GB",    None),
    ("Executive Dashboards", "consumption",  0, "BI",      None),
    ("Ad-hoc SQL Analytics", "consumption",  0, "BI",      None),
    ("ML Training",          "consumption",  0, "ML",      None),
    ("ML Serving",           "consumption",  0, "ML",      None),
    ("Data API Services",    "consumption",  0, "API",     None),
    ("Reverse ETL",          "consumption",  0, "Rev ETL", None),
]

# ============================================================
# LINK DATA
# ============================================================
# (source_idx, target_idx, volume_gb)
links = [
    (0, 6, 450), (1, 5, 250), (2, 6, 530), (3, 5, 60), (3, 6, 35), (4, 7, 235),
    (6, 8, 450), (6, 10, 530), (5, 9, 300), (5, 11, 95), (7, 12, 185), (6, 11, 35),
    (8, 13, 180), (9, 16, 110), (10, 15, 90), (9, 14, 25), (12, 14, 20), (11, 17, 20),
    (16, 18, 8), (14, 19, 3), (13, 20, 12), (16, 21, 5), (15, 22, 4),
    (18, 23, 4), (18, 24, 4), (21, 23, 2.5), (21, 27, 2.5),
    (19, 23, 1), (19, 25, 1), (19, 28, 1),
    (22, 24, 2), (22, 28, 2), (20, 25, 6), (20, 26, 6),
]

# ============================================================
# LAYOUT PARAMETERS
# ============================================================
FIG_W, FIG_H = 36, 26
DPI = 110

FLOW_TOP = 22.5
FLOW_BOTTOM = 8.5
FLOW_LEFT = 2.5
FLOW_RIGHT = 33.5

LAYER_NAMES = ["SOURCE", "INGESTION", "BRONZE", "SILVER", "GOLD", "CONSUMPTION"]
LAYER_KEYS = ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]
NUM_LAYERS = 6

COL_X = np.linspace(FLOW_LEFT + 1.2, FLOW_RIGHT - 1.2, NUM_LAYERS)
NODE_W = 1.1

# Power-scaled node heights for visual compression
POWER = 0.45
MAX_VOL = 1015
MAX_NODE_H = 8.5
MIN_NODE_H = 0.85
NODE_PAD = 0.2

PANEL_TOP = 7.5
PANEL_BOT = 0.3

# ============================================================
# COMPUTE VOLUMES
# ============================================================
node_vol_in = [0.0] * len(nodes)
node_vol_out = [0.0] * len(nodes)
for s, t, v in links:
    node_vol_out[s] += v
    node_vol_in[t] += v

node_effective_vol = []
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    if layer == 'consumption':
        node_effective_vol.append(max(node_vol_in[i], 7.5))
    else:
        node_effective_vol.append(max(node_vol_in[i], node_vol_out[i], vol, 1))

# Power-scaled heights
node_heights = []
for i in range(len(nodes)):
    h = MAX_NODE_H * (node_effective_vol[i] / MAX_VOL) ** POWER
    node_heights.append(max(h, MIN_NODE_H))

# ============================================================
# NODE POSITIONS
# ============================================================
layer_nodes = {k: [] for k in LAYER_KEYS}
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    layer_nodes[layer].append(i)

node_y_center = [0.0] * len(nodes)

for layer_key in LAYER_KEYS:
    idxs = layer_nodes[layer_key]
    total_h = sum(node_heights[i] for i in idxs) + NODE_PAD * (len(idxs) - 1)
    y_cursor = FLOW_TOP - (FLOW_TOP - FLOW_BOTTOM - total_h) / 2
    for i in idxs:
        node_y_center[i] = y_cursor - node_heights[i] / 2
        y_cursor -= node_heights[i] + NODE_PAD

# ============================================================
# TRACE SOURCE COLORS THROUGH PIPELINE
# ============================================================
def trace_source_color(node_idx, depth=0):
    if depth > 10:
        return LAYER_COLORS[nodes[node_idx][1]]
    if nodes[node_idx][1] == 'source' and nodes[node_idx][4]:
        return SRC_COLORS.get(nodes[node_idx][4], LAYER_COLORS['source'])
    incoming = [(s, v) for s, t, v in links if t == node_idx]
    if not incoming:
        return LAYER_COLORS[nodes[node_idx][1]]
    biggest_src = max(incoming, key=lambda x: x[1])[0]
    return trace_source_color(biggest_src, depth + 1)

node_flow_color = [trace_source_color(i) for i in range(len(nodes))]

# ============================================================
# CREATE FIGURE
# ============================================================
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H), dpi=DPI, facecolor='white')

ax = fig.add_axes([0, PANEL_TOP / FIG_H, 1, 1 - PANEL_TOP / FIG_H])
ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_W)
ax.set_ylim(FLOW_BOTTOM - 1.5, FLOW_TOP + 4.0)
ax.axis('off')

# ============================================================
# TITLE
# ============================================================
ax.text(FIG_W / 2, FLOW_TOP + 3.5,
        "Data Lakehouse Architecture",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=24, fontweight='bold', color='#0F172A')
ax.text(FIG_W / 2, FLOW_TOP + 2.6,
        "End-to-End Pipeline & Data Flow  |  Medallion Architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold)",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=13, color='#475569')

# ============================================================
# LAYER HEADERS WITH MEDALLION ICONS
# ============================================================
for i, (lname, lkey) in enumerate(zip(LAYER_NAMES, LAYER_KEYS)):
    x = COL_X[i]
    c = LAYER_COLORS[lkey]
    lc = LAYER_LIGHT[lkey]
    ax.text(x, FLOW_TOP + 1.4, lname, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color=c,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.35', facecolor=lc,
                      edgecolor=c, linewidth=2.5, alpha=0.9))

# ============================================================
# DRAW FLOW LINES (Bezier curves with variable width)
# ============================================================
def bezier_curve(p0, p1, n=30):
    """Create cubic Bezier curve points between two positions."""
    x0, y0 = p0
    x1, y1 = p1
    xm = (x0 + x1) / 2
    ctrl1 = (xm, y0)
    ctrl2 = (xm, y1)
    t = np.linspace(0, 1, n)
    x = (1-t)**3 * x0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t * ctrl1[0] + 3*(1-t)*t**2 * ctrl2[0] + t**3 * x1
    y = (1-t)**3 * y0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t * ctrl1[1] + 3*(1-t)*t**2 * ctrl2[1] + t**3 * y1
    return x, y

# Sort links by volume (draw smallest first so largest are on top)
sorted_links = sorted(links, key=lambda l: l[2])

for s, t, v in sorted_links:
    src_layer = nodes[s][1]
    tgt_layer = nodes[t][1]

    x_src = COL_X[LAYER_KEYS.index(src_layer)] + NODE_W / 2
    x_tgt = COL_X[LAYER_KEYS.index(tgt_layer)] - NODE_W / 2
    y_src = node_y_center[s]
    y_tgt = node_y_center[t]

    # Line width proportional to volume (power scale for visual compression)
    lw = 0.6 + 7.5 * (v / MAX_VOL) ** 0.45

    # Color from source category trace
    flow_color = node_flow_color[s]

    # Draw curve
    bx, by = bezier_curve((x_src, y_src), (x_tgt, y_tgt), n=40)
    ax.plot(bx, by, color=flow_color, linewidth=lw, alpha=0.35, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=1)

    # Small arrowhead at target
    dx = bx[-1] - bx[-3]
    dy = by[-1] - by[-3]
    arr_len = 0.25
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x_tgt, y_tgt),
                xytext=(x_tgt - arr_len * dx / max(abs(dx), 0.01),
                        y_tgt - arr_len * dy / max(abs(dy), 0.01)),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=flow_color, lw=min(lw * 0.6, 3)),
                zorder=2)

# ============================================================
# DRAW NODES
# ============================================================
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    col_idx = LAYER_KEYS.index(layer)
    x = COL_X[col_idx]
    yc = node_y_center[i]
    h = node_heights[i]

    if layer == 'source' and cat:
        edge_c = SRC_COLORS.get(cat, LAYER_COLORS[layer])
        fill_c = SRC_LIGHT.get(cat, LAYER_LIGHT[layer])
    else:
        edge_c = LAYER_COLORS[layer]
        fill_c = LAYER_LIGHT[layer]

    yb = yc - h / 2
    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - NODE_W / 2, yb), NODE_W, h,
        boxstyle=mpatches.BoxStyle("Round", pad=0.06),
        facecolor=fill_c, edgecolor=edge_c, linewidth=2.5, zorder=5
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    # Node text
    if h >= 1.2:
        ax.text(x, yc + 0.12, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color='#1E293B', zorder=6)
        if detail:
            ax.text(x, yc - 0.25, detail, ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=7, color='#475569', zorder=6, style='italic')
    elif h >= 0.85:
        ax.text(x, yc + 0.08, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', color='#1E293B', zorder=6)
        ax.text(x, yc - 0.18, detail, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=6, color='#475569', zorder=6, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(x, yc, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold', color='#1E293B', zorder=6,
                clip_on=True)

# ============================================================
# CONSUMPTION INCOMING VOLUME ANNOTATIONS
# ============================================================
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    if layer == 'consumption':
        col_idx = LAYER_KEYS.index(layer)
        x = COL_X[col_idx] + NODE_W / 2 + 0.12
        y = node_y_center[i]
        incoming_vol = sum(v for s, t, v in links if t == i)
        if incoming_vol > 0:
            ax.text(x, y, f"  {incoming_vol:.0f} GB", ha='left', va='center',
                    fontsize=6.5, color='#64748B', zorder=7)

# ============================================================
# VOLUME REDUCTION SUMMARY
# ============================================================
total_src = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'source')
total_brz = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'bronze')
total_slv = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'silver')
total_gld = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'gold')
pct = (1 - total_gld / total_src) * 100

ax.text(FIG_W / 2, FLOW_BOTTOM - 0.5,
        f"Daily Volume:  {total_src:,} GB (Source)  →  {total_brz:,} GB (Bronze)  →  "
        f"{total_slv:,} GB (Silver)  →  {total_gld:,} GB (Gold)   —   "
        f"{pct:.1f}% total reduction from raw to refined",
        ha='center', va='top', fontsize=10, color='#334155',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor='#F1F5F9',
                  edgecolor='#94A3B8', linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.9))

# ============================================================
# GOVERNANCE VERTICAL STRIP (cross-layer overlay)
# ============================================================
# Subtle dashed red vertical bar on far right to indicate governance spans all layers
gov_x = FLOW_RIGHT + 0.5
for yy in np.linspace(FLOW_BOTTOM, FLOW_TOP, 25):
    ax.plot([gov_x, gov_x], [yy, yy + (FLOW_TOP - FLOW_BOTTOM) / 50],
            color='#DC2626', linewidth=2.0, alpha=0.35, zorder=0)

ax.text(gov_x, FLOW_TOP + 1.4, "GOV", ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='#DC2626',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='#FEE2E2',
                  edgecolor='#DC2626', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.9))

# Small governance labels at each layer
gov_labels = {
    'ingestion': 'Schema Val.\nQuality Gate',
    'bronze': 'Audit Log\nPII Detect',
    'silver': 'Encryption\nLineage\nRow Security',
    'gold': 'RBAC\nCertification\nUsage Track',
    'consumption': 'Auth\nRate Limit',
}
for layer_key, glabel in gov_labels.items():
    col_idx = LAYER_KEYS.index(layer_key)
    x = COL_X[col_idx]
    # Find y-center of layer
    idxs = layer_nodes[layer_key]
    y_top = node_y_center[idxs[0]] + node_heights[idxs[0]] / 2
    y_bot = node_y_center[idxs[-1]] - node_heights[idxs[-1]] / 2
    y_mid = (y_top + y_bot) / 2
    # Draw a small bracket on the left
    bx = x - NODE_W / 2 - 0.15
    ax.plot([bx - 0.3, bx - 0.3], [y_top, y_bot], color='#DC2626', linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.4, zorder=0)
    ax.text(bx - 0.4, y_mid, glabel, ha='right', va='center',
            fontsize=5.5, color='#DC2626', alpha=0.6, zorder=0)

# ============================================================
# SOURCE CATEGORY LEGEND
# ============================================================
leg_x = FLOW_LEFT + 0.3
leg_y = FLOW_BOTTOM - 1.2
ax.text(leg_x, leg_y, "Source Categories:", fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='#475569')
for ci, (cat_name, cat_color) in enumerate(SRC_COLORS.items()):
    xoff = leg_x + ci * 2.8
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (xoff, leg_y - 0.5), 0.3, 0.3,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.03", facecolor=SRC_LIGHT[cat_name],
        edgecolor=cat_color, linewidth=1.5, zorder=5))
    ax.text(xoff + 0.4, leg_y - 0.35, cat_name, fontsize=6.5, color='#334155', va='center')

# ============================================================
# TRANSFORMATION SUMMARY PANEL (bottom-left)
# ============================================================
ax_t = fig.add_axes([1.5 / FIG_W, PANEL_BOT / FIG_H,
                      14.5 / FIG_W, (PANEL_TOP - PANEL_BOT - 0.3) / FIG_H])
ax_t.set_facecolor('#FAFBFC')

trans_data = [
    ('Bronze', 'Schema-on-Read', 10, 'low', LAYER_COLORS['bronze']),
    ('Bronze', 'Deduplication', 5, 'low', LAYER_COLORS['bronze']),
    ('Bronze', 'Timestamp Norm.', 8, 'low', LAYER_COLORS['bronze']),
    ('Silver', 'Null/Outlier Clean', 12, 'medium', LAYER_COLORS['silver']),
    ('Silver', 'SCD2 Conformance', 5, 'high', LAYER_COLORS['silver']),
    ('Silver', 'Join / Enrichment', 8, 'high', LAYER_COLORS['silver']),
    ('Silver', 'Sessionization', 3, 'high', LAYER_COLORS['silver']),
    ('Silver', 'PII Masking', 6, 'medium', LAYER_COLORS['silver']),
    ('Gold', 'Aggregation / Roll-up', 10, 'medium', LAYER_COLORS['gold']),
    ('Gold', 'Feature Engineering', 7, 'high', LAYER_COLORS['gold']),
    ('Gold', 'Business Logic / KPI', 8, 'high', LAYER_COLORS['gold']),
    ('Gold', 'Materialized Views', 5, 'medium', LAYER_COLORS['gold']),
]

comp_fill = {'low': '#BBF7D0', 'medium': '#FEF08A', 'high': '#FECACA'}
comp_edge = {'low': '#16A34A', 'medium': '#CA8A04', 'high': '#DC2626'}

y_pos = list(range(len(trans_data)))
labels_t = [f"{d[0]}: {d[1]}" for d in trans_data]
widths = [d[2] for d in trans_data]
fills = [comp_fill[d[3]] for d in trans_data]
edges = [comp_edge[d[3]] for d in trans_data]

ax_t.barh(y_pos, widths, color=fills, edgecolor=edges,
           linewidth=1.3, height=0.65, zorder=3)

for yi, w in zip(y_pos, widths):
    ax_t.text(w + 0.3, yi, str(w), va='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#334155', fontweight='bold')

ax_t.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax_t.set_yticklabels(labels_t, fontsize=7.5, color='#334155')
ax_t.invert_yaxis()
ax_t.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=8.5, color='#475569')
ax_t.set_title('Transformation Stages by Medallion Layer',
               fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#0F172A', pad=10)

# Layer separators
ax_t.axhline(2.5, color='#CBD5E1', lw=0.8, ls='--', zorder=2)
ax_t.axhline(7.5, color='#CBD5E1', lw=0.8, ls='--', zorder=2)

from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_patches = [
    Patch(facecolor=comp_fill['low'], edgecolor=comp_edge['low'], label='Low'),
    Patch(facecolor=comp_fill['medium'], edgecolor=comp_edge['medium'], label='Medium'),
    Patch(facecolor=comp_fill['high'], edgecolor=comp_edge['high'], label='High'),
]
ax_t.legend(handles=legend_patches, title='Complexity', loc='lower right',
            fontsize=7, title_fontsize=7.5, framealpha=0.9)
ax_t.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_t.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_t.set_xlim(0, max(widths) + 3)
ax_t.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=7.5)

# Total transformations per layer
brz_total = sum(d[2] for d in trans_data if d[0] == 'Bronze')
slv_total = sum(d[2] for d in trans_data if d[0] == 'Silver')
gld_total = sum(d[2] for d in trans_data if d[0] == 'Gold')
ax_t.text(max(widths) + 2.5, 1, f'Total: {brz_total}', fontsize=7, color=LAYER_COLORS['bronze'], fontweight='bold', va='center')
ax_t.text(max(widths) + 2.5, 5, f'Total: {slv_total}', fontsize=7, color=LAYER_COLORS['silver'], fontweight='bold', va='center')
ax_t.text(max(widths) + 2.5, 10.5, f'Total: {gld_total}', fontsize=7, color=LAYER_COLORS['gold'], fontweight='bold', va='center')

# ============================================================
# GOVERNANCE CONTROLS PANEL (bottom-right)
# ============================================================
ax_g = fig.add_axes([17.5 / FIG_W, PANEL_BOT / FIG_H,
                      17.0 / FIG_W, (PANEL_TOP - PANEL_BOT - 0.3) / FIG_H])
ax_g.set_facecolor('#FAFBFC')
ax_g.axis('off')
ax_g.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax_g.set_ylim(0, 1)

ax_g.text(0.5, 0.97, 'Cross-Cutting Data Governance Controls', ha='center', va='top',

import os

LAYER_BG = {
    'source':     '#F0F5FF',

SRC_LIGHT = {
    'IoT/Streaming':     '#DBEAFE',
    'Enterprise Apps':   '#D1FAE5',
    'Logs/Clickstream':  '#FEF3C7',
    'External/3rd Party':'#EDE9FE',
    'Databases':         '#CFFAFE',
}

# ============================================================
# NODE DATA
# ============================================================
nodes = [
    ("IoT / Streaming",      "source",     450, "450 GB/day", "IoT/Streaming"),
    ("Enterprise Apps",      "source",     250, "250 GB/day", "Enterprise Apps"),
    ("Logs / Clickstream",   "source",     530, "530 GB/day", "Logs/Clickstream"),
    ("External / 3rd Party", "source",      95, "95 GB/day",  "External/3rd Party"),
    ("Databases",            "source",     235, "235 GB/day", "Databases"),
    ("Batch Ingestion",      "ingestion",  310, "Spark / ADF",     None),
    ("Stream Ingestion",     "ingestion", 1015, "Kafka / EventHub", None),
    ("CDC Connector",        "ingestion",  235, "Debezium",        None),
    ("Raw IoT Events",       "bronze",     450, "450 GB",  None),
    ("Raw Transactions",     "bronze",     300, "300 GB",  None),
    ("Raw Log Data",         "bronze",     530, "530 GB",  None),
    ("Raw External Data",    "bronze",     130, "130 GB",  None),
    ("Raw DB Snapshots",     "bronze",     185, "185 GB",  None),
    ("Cleaned IoT Metrics",  "silver",     180, "180 GB",  None),
    ("Unified Customer 360", "silver",      45, "45 GB",   None),
    ("Sessionized Clicks",   "silver",      90, "90 GB",   None),
    ("Enriched Transactions","silver",     110, "110 GB",  None),
    ("Normalized Market",    "silver",      20, "20 GB",   None),
    ("Revenue Aggregates",   "gold",         8, "8 GB",    None),
    ("Customer LTV Scores",  "gold",         3, "3 GB",    None),
    ("Anomaly Detection",    "gold",        12, "12 GB",   None),
    ("Product Perf KPIs",    "gold",         5, "5 GB",    None),
    ("Marketing Attribution","gold",         4, "4 GB",    None),
    ("Executive Dashboards", "consumption",  0, "BI",      None),
    ("Ad-hoc SQL Analytics", "consumption",  0, "BI",      None),
    ("ML Training",          "consumption",  0, "ML",      None),
    ("ML Serving",           "consumption",  0, "ML",      None),
    ("Data API Services",    "consumption",  0, "API",     None),
    ("Reverse ETL",          "consumption",  0, "Rev ETL", None),
]

# ============================================================
# LINK DATA
# ============================================================
links = [
    (0, 6, 450), (1, 5, 250), (2, 6, 530), (3, 5, 60), (3, 6, 35), (4, 7, 235),
    (6, 8, 450), (6, 10, 530), (5, 9, 300), (5, 11, 95), (7, 12, 185), (6, 11, 35),
    (8, 13, 180), (9, 16, 110), (10, 15, 90), (9, 14, 25), (12, 14, 20), (11, 17, 20),
    (16, 18, 8), (14, 19, 3), (13, 20, 12), (16, 21, 5), (15, 22, 4),
    (18, 23, 4), (18, 24, 4), (21, 23, 2.5), (21, 27, 2.5),
    (19, 23, 1), (19, 25, 1), (19, 28, 1),
    (22, 24, 2), (22, 28, 2), (20, 25, 6), (20, 26, 6),
]

# ============================================================
# LAYOUT
# ============================================================
FIG_W, FIG_H = 38, 28
DPI = 110

FLOW_TOP = 23.5
FLOW_BOTTOM = 9.0
FLOW_LEFT = 2.5
FLOW_RIGHT = 35.5

LAYER_NAMES = ["SOURCE", "INGESTION", "BRONZE", "SILVER", "GOLD", "CONSUMPTION"]
LAYER_KEYS = ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]
NUM_LAYERS = 6

COL_X = np.linspace(FLOW_LEFT + 1.5, FLOW_RIGHT - 1.5, NUM_LAYERS)
NODE_W = 1.15

POWER = 0.45
MAX_VOL = 1015
MAX_NODE_H = 9.0
MIN_NODE_H = 0.95
NODE_PAD = 0.22

PANEL_TOP = 8.0
PANEL_BOT = 0.3

# ============================================================
# COMPUTE VOLUMES & POSITIONS
# ============================================================
node_vol_in = [0.0] * len(nodes)
node_vol_out = [0.0] * len(nodes)
for s, t, v in links:
    node_vol_out[s] += v
    node_vol_in[t] += v

node_effective_vol = []
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    if layer == 'consumption':
        node_effective_vol.append(max(node_vol_in[i], 7.5))
    else:
        node_effective_vol.append(max(node_vol_in[i], node_vol_out[i], vol, 1))

node_heights = [max(MAX_NODE_H * (ev / MAX_VOL) ** POWER, MIN_NODE_H) for ev in node_effective_vol]

layer_nodes = {k: [] for k in LAYER_KEYS}
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    layer_nodes[layer].append(i)

node_y_center = [0.0] * len(nodes)
for layer_key in LAYER_KEYS:
    idxs = layer_nodes[layer_key]
    total_h = sum(node_heights[i] for i in idxs) + NODE_PAD * (len(idxs) - 1)
    y_cursor = FLOW_TOP - (FLOW_TOP - FLOW_BOTTOM - total_h) / 2
    for i in idxs:
        node_y_center[i] = y_cursor - node_heights[i] / 2
        y_cursor -= node_heights[i] + NODE_PAD

# ============================================================
# TRACE SOURCE COLORS
# ============================================================
def trace_source_color(nidx, depth=0):
    if depth > 10:
        return LAYER_COLORS[nodes[nidx][1]]
    if nodes[nidx][1] == 'source' and nodes[nidx][4]:
        return SRC_COLORS.get(nodes[nidx][4], LAYER_COLORS['source'])
    incoming = [(s, v) for s, t, v in links if t == nidx]
    if not incoming:
        return LAYER_COLORS[nodes[nidx][1]]
    return trace_source_color(max(incoming, key=lambda x: x[1])[0], depth + 1)

node_flow_color = [trace_source_color(i) for i in range(len(nodes))]

# ============================================================
# FIGURE
# ============================================================
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H), dpi=DPI, facecolor='white')
ax = fig.add_axes([0, PANEL_TOP / FIG_H, 1, 1 - PANEL_TOP / FIG_H])
ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_W)
ax.set_ylim(FLOW_BOTTOM - 2.0, FLOW_TOP + 4.5)
ax.axis('off')

# ============================================================
# LAYER BACKGROUND COLUMNS
# ============================================================
col_half_w = (COL_X[1] - COL_X[0]) / 2 + 0.1
for i, lkey in enumerate(LAYER_KEYS):
    bg_rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (COL_X[i] - col_half_w, FLOW_BOTTOM - 0.3),
        2 * col_half_w, FLOW_TOP - FLOW_BOTTOM + 0.6,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.15",
        facecolor=LAYER_BG[lkey], edgecolor='none', alpha=0.5, zorder=0
    )
    ax.add_patch(bg_rect)

# ============================================================
# TITLE
# ============================================================
ax.text(FIG_W / 2, FLOW_TOP + 3.8,
        "Data Lakehouse Architecture",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=26, fontweight='bold', color='#0F172A')
ax.text(FIG_W / 2, FLOW_TOP + 2.8,
        "End-to-End Pipeline & Data Flow  ·  Medallion Architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold)  ·  Governance Overlay",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12, color='#475569')

# ============================================================
# LAYER HEADERS
# ============================================================
for i, (lname, lkey) in enumerate(zip(LAYER_NAMES, LAYER_KEYS)):
    x = COL_X[i]
    c = LAYER_COLORS[lkey]
    lc = LAYER_LIGHT[lkey]
    ax.text(x, FLOW_TOP + 1.6, lname, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color=c,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.35', facecolor=lc,
                      edgecolor=c, linewidth=2.5, alpha=0.9))

# ============================================================
# CROSS-LAYER GOVERNANCE STRIP
# ============================================================
gov_x = FLOW_RIGHT + 0.8
# Draw a red vertical band
gov_rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
    (gov_x - 0.25, FLOW_BOTTOM - 0.3), 0.5, FLOW_TOP - FLOW_BOTTOM + 0.6,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
    facecolor='#FEE2E2', edgecolor='#DC2626', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.5, zorder=0
)
ax.add_patch(gov_rect)
ax.text(gov_x, FLOW_TOP + 1.6, "GOV", ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='#DC2626',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='#FEE2E2',
                  edgecolor='#DC2626', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.9))

# Small governance markers at each layer
gov_marks = {
    'ingestion': ('Schema Val.', 'Quality Gate'),
    'bronze': ('Audit Log', 'PII Detect'),
    'silver': ('Encryption', 'Lineage', 'Row Sec.'),
    'gold': ('RBAC', 'Certification', 'Tracking'),
    'consumption': ('Auth', 'Rate Limit'),
}
for lkey, marks in gov_marks.items():
    col_idx = LAYER_KEYS.index(lkey)
    idxs = layer_nodes[lkey]
    y_top = node_y_center[idxs[0]] + node_heights[idxs[0]] / 2
    y_bot = node_y_center[idxs[-1]] - node_heights[idxs[-1]] / 2
    y_mid = (y_top + y_bot) / 2
    # Small colored dots on the governance strip
    ax.plot(gov_x, y_mid, 'o', color='#DC2626', markersize=4, alpha=0.6, zorder=1)
    ax.text(gov_x + 0.35, y_mid, '\n'.join(marks), ha='left', va='center',
            fontsize=5.5, color='#B91C1C', alpha=0.7, zorder=1, linespacing=1.3)

# ============================================================
# DRAW FLOW LINES
# ============================================================
def bezier_pts(p0, p1, n=50):
    x0, y0 = p0
    x1, y1 = p1
    xm = (x0 + x1) / 2
    t = np.linspace(0, 1, n)
    x = (1-t)**3*x0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t*xm + 3*(1-t)*t**2*xm + t**3*x1
    y = (1-t)**3*y0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t*y0 + 3*(1-t)*t**2*y1 + t**3*y1
    return x, y

sorted_links = sorted(links, key=lambda l: l[2])

for s, t, v in sorted_links:
    src_layer = nodes[s][1]
    tgt_layer = nodes[t][1]
    x_src = COL_X[LAYER_KEYS.index(src_layer)] + NODE_W / 2 + 0.02
    x_tgt = COL_X[LAYER_KEYS.index(tgt_layer)] - NODE_W / 2 - 0.02
    y_src = node_y_center[s]
    y_tgt = node_y_center[t]

    lw = 0.5 + 8.0 * (v / MAX_VOL) ** 0.45
    fc = node_flow_color[s]

    bx, by = bezier_pts((x_src, y_src), (x_tgt, y_tgt), n=50)
    ax.plot(bx, by, color=fc, linewidth=lw, alpha=0.30,
            solid_capstyle='round', zorder=1)

    # Arrowhead
    dx = bx[-1] - bx[-4]
    dy = by[-1] - by[-4]
    norm = max(math.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2), 0.01)
    arr_len = 0.22
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x_tgt + 0.02, y_tgt),
                xytext=(x_tgt + 0.02 - arr_len * dx / norm,
                        y_tgt - arr_len * dy / norm),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', color=fc,
                                lw=max(lw * 0.4, 0.8), mutation_scale=8),
                zorder=2)

# ============================================================
# DRAW NODES
# ============================================================
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    col_idx = LAYER_KEYS.index(layer)
    x = COL_X[col_idx]
    yc = node_y_center[i]
    h = node_heights[i]

def bezier_pts(p0, p1, n=50):
    x0, y0 = p0
    x1, y1 = p1
    xm = (x0 + x1) / 2
    t = np.linspace(0, 1, n)
    x = (1-t)**3*x0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t*xm + 3*(1-t)*t**2*xm + t**3*x1
    y = (1-t)**3*y0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t*y0 + 3*(1-t)*t**2*y1 + t**3*y1
    return x, y

    x_tgt = COL_X[LAYER_KEYS.index(tgt_layer)] - NODE_W / 2 - 0.02
    y_src = node_y_center[s]
    y_tgt = node_y_center[t]

    lw = 0.5 + 8.0 * (v / MAX_VOL) ** 0.45
    fc = node_flow_color[s]

    bx, by = bezier_pts((x_src, y_src), (x_tgt, y_tgt), n=50)
    ax.plot(bx, by, color=fc, linewidth=lw, alpha=0.30,
            solid_capstyle='round', zorder=1)

    # Arrowhead
    dx = bx[-1] - bx[-4]
    dy = by[-1] - by[-4]
    norm = max(math.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2), 0.01)
    arr_len = 0.22
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x_tgt + 0.02, y_tgt),
                xytext=(x_tgt + 0.02 - arr_len * dx / norm,
                        y_tgt - arr_len * dy / norm),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', color=fc,

                zorder=2)

def bezier_pts(p0, p1, n=50):
    x0, y0 = p0
    x1, y1 = p1
    xm = (x0 + x1) / 2
    t = np.linspace(0, 1, n)
    x = (1-t)**3*x0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t*xm + 3*(1-t)*t**2*xm + t**3*x1
    y = (1-t)**3*y0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t*y0 + 3*(1-t)*t**2*y1 + t**3*y1
    return x, y
