import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
import numpy as np
import math
import os

os.makedirs('/app/output', exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================
# COLOR PALETTE
# ============================================================
LAYER_COLORS = {
    'source':     '#3B82F6',
    'ingestion':  '#059669',
    'bronze':     '#B45309',
    'silver':     '#64748B',
    'gold':       '#D97706',
    'consumption':'#7C3AED',
    'crosslayer': '#DC2626',
}

LAYER_LIGHT = {
    'source':     '#DBEAFE',
    'ingestion':  '#D1FAE5',
    'bronze':     '#FEF3C7',
    'silver':     '#E2E8F0',
    'gold':       '#FEF3C7',
    'consumption':'#EDE9FE',
}

LAYER_BG = {
    'source':     '#F0F5FF',
    'ingestion':  '#F0FDF4',
    'bronze':     '#FFFBEB',
    'silver':     '#F8FAFC',
    'gold':       '#FFFBEB',
    'consumption':'#FAF5FF',
}

SRC_COLORS = {
    'IoT/Streaming':     '#2563EB',
    'Enterprise Apps':   '#059669',
    'Logs/Clickstream':  '#D97706',
    'External/3rd Party':'#7C3AED',
    'Databases':         '#0891B2',
}

SRC_LIGHT = {
    'IoT/Streaming':     '#DBEAFE',
    'Enterprise Apps':   '#D1FAE5',
    'Logs/Clickstream':  '#FEF3C7',
    'External/3rd Party':'#EDE9FE',
    'Databases':         '#CFFAFE',
}

# ============================================================
# NODE DATA
# ============================================================
nodes = [
    ("IoT / Streaming",      "source",     450, "450 GB/day", "IoT/Streaming"),
    ("Enterprise Apps",      "source",     250, "250 GB/day", "Enterprise Apps"),
    ("Logs / Clickstream",   "source",     530, "530 GB/day", "Logs/Clickstream"),
    ("External / 3rd Party", "source",      95, "95 GB/day",  "External/3rd Party"),
    ("Databases",            "source",     235, "235 GB/day", "Databases"),
    ("Batch Ingestion",      "ingestion",  310, "Spark / ADF",     None),
    ("Stream Ingestion",     "ingestion", 1015, "Kafka / EventHub", None),
    ("CDC Connector",        "ingestion",  235, "Debezium",        None),
    ("Raw IoT Events",       "bronze",     450, "450 GB",  None),
    ("Raw Transactions",     "bronze",     300, "300 GB",  None),
    ("Raw Log Data",         "bronze",     530, "530 GB",  None),
    ("Raw External Data",    "bronze",     130, "130 GB",  None),
    ("Raw DB Snapshots",     "bronze",     185, "185 GB",  None),
    ("Cleaned IoT Metrics",  "silver",     180, "180 GB",  None),
    ("Unified Customer 360", "silver",      45, "45 GB",   None),
    ("Sessionized Clicks",   "silver",      90, "90 GB",   None),
    ("Enriched Transactions","silver",     110, "110 GB",  None),
    ("Normalized Market",    "silver",      20, "20 GB",   None),
    ("Revenue Aggregates",   "gold",         8, "8 GB",    None),
    ("Customer LTV Scores",  "gold",         3, "3 GB",    None),
    ("Anomaly Detection",    "gold",        12, "12 GB",   None),
    ("Product Perf KPIs",    "gold",         5, "5 GB",    None),
    ("Marketing Attribution","gold",         4, "4 GB",    None),
    ("Executive Dashboards", "consumption",  0, "BI",      None),
    ("Ad-hoc SQL Analytics", "consumption",  0, "BI",      None),
    ("ML Training",          "consumption",  0, "ML",      None),
    ("ML Serving",           "consumption",  0, "ML",      None),
    ("Data API Services",    "consumption",  0, "API",     None),
    ("Reverse ETL",          "consumption",  0, "Rev ETL", None),
]

# ============================================================
# LINK DATA
# ============================================================
links = [
    (0, 6, 450), (1, 5, 250), (2, 6, 530), (3, 5, 60), (3, 6, 35), (4, 7, 235),
    (6, 8, 450), (6, 10, 530), (5, 9, 300), (5, 11, 95), (7, 12, 185), (6, 11, 35),
    (8, 13, 180), (9, 16, 110), (10, 15, 90), (9, 14, 25), (12, 14, 20), (11, 17, 20),
    (16, 18, 8), (14, 19, 3), (13, 20, 12), (16, 21, 5), (15, 22, 4),
    (18, 23, 4), (18, 24, 4), (21, 23, 2.5), (21, 27, 2.5),
    (19, 23, 1), (19, 25, 1), (19, 28, 1),
    (22, 24, 2), (22, 28, 2), (20, 25, 6), (20, 26, 6),
]

# ============================================================
# LAYOUT
# ============================================================
FIG_W, FIG_H = 38, 28
DPI = 110

FLOW_TOP = 23.5
FLOW_BOTTOM = 9.0
FLOW_LEFT = 2.5
FLOW_RIGHT = 35.5

LAYER_NAMES = ["SOURCE", "INGESTION", "BRONZE", "SILVER", "GOLD", "CONSUMPTION"]
LAYER_KEYS = ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]
NUM_LAYERS = 6

COL_X = np.linspace(FLOW_LEFT + 1.5, FLOW_RIGHT - 1.5, NUM_LAYERS)
NODE_W = 1.15

POWER = 0.45
MAX_VOL = 1015
MAX_NODE_H = 9.0
MIN_NODE_H = 0.95
NODE_PAD = 0.22

PANEL_TOP = 8.0
PANEL_BOT = 0.3

# ============================================================
# COMPUTE VOLUMES & POSITIONS
# ============================================================
node_vol_in = [0.0] * len(nodes)
node_vol_out = [0.0] * len(nodes)
for s, t, v in links:
    node_vol_out[s] += v
    node_vol_in[t] += v

node_effective_vol = []
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    if layer == 'consumption':
        node_effective_vol.append(max(node_vol_in[i], 7.5))
    else:
        node_effective_vol.append(max(node_vol_in[i], node_vol_out[i], vol, 1))

node_heights = [max(MAX_NODE_H * (ev / MAX_VOL) ** POWER, MIN_NODE_H) for ev in node_effective_vol]

layer_nodes = {k: [] for k in LAYER_KEYS}
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    layer_nodes[layer].append(i)

node_y_center = [0.0] * len(nodes)
for layer_key in LAYER_KEYS:
    idxs = layer_nodes[layer_key]
    total_h = sum(node_heights[i] for i in idxs) + NODE_PAD * (len(idxs) - 1)
    y_cursor = FLOW_TOP - (FLOW_TOP - FLOW_BOTTOM - total_h) / 2
    for i in idxs:
        node_y_center[i] = y_cursor - node_heights[i] / 2
        y_cursor -= node_heights[i] + NODE_PAD

# ============================================================
# TRACE SOURCE COLORS
# ============================================================
def trace_source_color(nidx, depth=0):
    if depth > 10:
        return LAYER_COLORS[nodes[nidx][1]]
    if nodes[nidx][1] == 'source' and nodes[nidx][4]:
        return SRC_COLORS.get(nodes[nidx][4], LAYER_COLORS['source'])
    incoming = [(s, v) for s, t, v in links if t == nidx]
    if not incoming:
        return LAYER_COLORS[nodes[nidx][1]]
    return trace_source_color(max(incoming, key=lambda x: x[1])[0], depth + 1)

node_flow_color = [trace_source_color(i) for i in range(len(nodes))]

# ============================================================
# FIGURE
# ============================================================
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H), dpi=DPI, facecolor='white')
ax = fig.add_axes([0, PANEL_TOP / FIG_H, 1, 1 - PANEL_TOP / FIG_H])
ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_W)
ax.set_ylim(FLOW_BOTTOM - 2.0, FLOW_TOP + 4.5)
ax.axis('off')

# ============================================================
# LAYER BACKGROUND COLUMNS
# ============================================================
col_half_w = (COL_X[1] - COL_X[0]) / 2 + 0.1
for i, lkey in enumerate(LAYER_KEYS):
    bg_rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (COL_X[i] - col_half_w, FLOW_BOTTOM - 0.3),
        2 * col_half_w, FLOW_TOP - FLOW_BOTTOM + 0.6,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.15",
        facecolor=LAYER_BG[lkey], edgecolor='none', alpha=0.5, zorder=0
    )
    ax.add_patch(bg_rect)

# ============================================================
# TITLE
# ============================================================
ax.text(FIG_W / 2, FLOW_TOP + 3.8,
        "Data Lakehouse Architecture",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=26, fontweight='bold', color='#0F172A')
ax.text(FIG_W / 2, FLOW_TOP + 2.8,
        "End-to-End Pipeline & Data Flow  ·  Medallion Architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold)  ·  Governance Overlay",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12, color='#475569')

# ============================================================
# LAYER HEADERS
# ============================================================
for i, (lname, lkey) in enumerate(zip(LAYER_NAMES, LAYER_KEYS)):
    x = COL_X[i]
    c = LAYER_COLORS[lkey]
    lc = LAYER_LIGHT[lkey]
    ax.text(x, FLOW_TOP + 1.6, lname, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color=c,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.35', facecolor=lc,
                      edgecolor=c, linewidth=2.5, alpha=0.9))

# ============================================================
# CROSS-LAYER GOVERNANCE STRIP
# ============================================================
gov_x = FLOW_RIGHT + 0.8
# Draw a red vertical band
gov_rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
    (gov_x - 0.25, FLOW_BOTTOM - 0.3), 0.5, FLOW_TOP - FLOW_BOTTOM + 0.6,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
    facecolor='#FEE2E2', edgecolor='#DC2626', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.5, zorder=0
)
ax.add_patch(gov_rect)
ax.text(gov_x, FLOW_TOP + 1.6, "GOV", ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='#DC2626',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='#FEE2E2',
                  edgecolor='#DC2626', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.9))

# Small governance markers at each layer
gov_marks = {
    'ingestion': ('Schema Val.', 'Quality Gate'),
    'bronze': ('Audit Log', 'PII Detect'),
    'silver': ('Encryption', 'Lineage', 'Row Sec.'),
    'gold': ('RBAC', 'Certification', 'Tracking'),
    'consumption': ('Auth', 'Rate Limit'),
}
for lkey, marks in gov_marks.items():
    col_idx = LAYER_KEYS.index(lkey)
    idxs = layer_nodes[lkey]
    y_top = node_y_center[idxs[0]] + node_heights[idxs[0]] / 2
    y_bot = node_y_center[idxs[-1]] - node_heights[idxs[-1]] / 2
    y_mid = (y_top + y_bot) / 2
    # Small colored dots on the governance strip
    ax.plot(gov_x, y_mid, 'o', color='#DC2626', markersize=4, alpha=0.6, zorder=1)
    ax.text(gov_x + 0.35, y_mid, '\n'.join(marks), ha='left', va='center',
            fontsize=5.5, color='#B91C1C', alpha=0.7, zorder=1, linespacing=1.3)

# ============================================================
# DRAW FLOW LINES
# ============================================================
def bezier_pts(p0, p1, n=50):
    x0, y0 = p0
    x1, y1 = p1
    xm = (x0 + x1) / 2
    t = np.linspace(0, 1, n)
    x = (1-t)**3*x0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t*xm + 3*(1-t)*t**2*xm + t**3*x1
    y = (1-t)**3*y0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t*y0 + 3*(1-t)*t**2*y1 + t**3*y1
    return x, y

sorted_links = sorted(links, key=lambda l: l[2])

for s, t, v in sorted_links:
    src_layer = nodes[s][1]
    tgt_layer = nodes[t][1]
    x_src = COL_X[LAYER_KEYS.index(src_layer)] + NODE_W / 2 + 0.02
    x_tgt = COL_X[LAYER_KEYS.index(tgt_layer)] - NODE_W / 2 - 0.02
    y_src = node_y_center[s]
    y_tgt = node_y_center[t]

    lw = 0.5 + 8.0 * (v / MAX_VOL) ** 0.45
    fc = node_flow_color[s]

    bx, by = bezier_pts((x_src, y_src), (x_tgt, y_tgt), n=50)
    ax.plot(bx, by, color=fc, linewidth=lw, alpha=0.30,
            solid_capstyle='round', zorder=1)

    # Arrowhead
    dx = bx[-1] - bx[-4]
    dy = by[-1] - by[-4]
    norm = max(math.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2), 0.01)
    arr_len = 0.22
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x_tgt + 0.02, y_tgt),
                xytext=(x_tgt + 0.02 - arr_len * dx / norm,
                        y_tgt - arr_len * dy / norm),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', color=fc,
                                lw=max(lw * 0.4, 0.8), mutation_scale=8),
                zorder=2)

# ============================================================
# DRAW NODES
# ============================================================
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    col_idx = LAYER_KEYS.index(layer)
    x = COL_X[col_idx]
    yc = node_y_center[i]
    h = node_heights[i]

    if layer == 'source' and cat:
        edge_c = SRC_COLORS.get(cat, LAYER_COLORS[layer])
        fill_c = SRC_LIGHT.get(cat, LAYER_LIGHT[layer])
    else:
        edge_c = LAYER_COLORS[layer]
        fill_c = LAYER_LIGHT[layer]

    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - NODE_W / 2, yc - h / 2), NODE_W, h,
        boxstyle=mpatches.BoxStyle("Round", pad=0.07),
        facecolor=fill_c, edgecolor=edge_c, linewidth=2.5, zorder=5
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    # Text
    if h >= 1.3:
        ax.text(x, yc + 0.15, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color='#1E293B', zorder=6)
        if detail:
            ax.text(x, yc - 0.28, detail, ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=7, color='#475569', zorder=6, style='italic')
    elif h >= 0.9:
        ax.text(x, yc + 0.06, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', color='#1E293B', zorder=6)
        ax.text(x, yc - 0.2, detail, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=6, color='#475569', zorder=6, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(x, yc, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold', color='#1E293B', zorder=6,
                clip_on=True)

# ============================================================
# CONSUMPTION VOLUME LABELS
# ============================================================
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    if layer == 'consumption':
        x = COL_X[LAYER_KEYS.index(layer)] + NODE_W / 2 + 0.1

                    fontsize=6.5, color='#64748B', zorder=7)

# ============================================================
total_src = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'source')
total_brz = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'bronze')

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
import numpy as np
import math
import os

os.makedirs('/app/output', exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================
# COLOR PALETTE
# ============================================================
LAYER_COLORS = {
    'source':     '#3B82F6',
    'ingestion':  '#059669',
    'bronze':     '#B45309',
    'silver':     '#64748B',
    'gold':       '#D97706',
    'consumption':'#7C3AED',
    'crosslayer': '#DC2626',
}

LAYER_LIGHT = {
    'source':     '#DBEAFE',
    'ingestion':  '#D1FAE5',
    'bronze':     '#FEF3C7',
    'silver':     '#E2E8F0',
    'gold':       '#FEF3C7',
    'consumption':'#EDE9FE',
}

LAYER_BG = {
    'source':     '#F0F5FF',
    'ingestion':  '#F0FDF4',
    'bronze':     '#FFFBEB',
    'silver':     '#F8FAFC',
    'gold':       '#FFFBEB',
    'consumption':'#FAF5FF',
}

SRC_COLORS = {
    'IoT/Streaming':     '#2563EB',
    'Enterprise Apps':   '#059669',
    'Logs/Clickstream':  '#D97706',
    'External/3rd Party':'#7C3AED',
    'Databases':         '#0891B2',
}

SRC_LIGHT = {
    'IoT/Streaming':     '#DBEAFE',
    'Enterprise Apps':   '#D1FAE5',
    'Logs/Clickstream':  '#FEF3C7',
    'External/3rd Party':'#EDE9FE',
    'Databases':         '#CFFAFE',
}

# ============================================================
# NODE DATA
# ============================================================
nodes = [
    ("IoT / Streaming",      "source",     450, "450 GB/day", "IoT/Streaming"),
    ("Enterprise Apps",      "source",     250, "250 GB/day", "Enterprise Apps"),
    ("Logs / Clickstream",   "source",     530, "530 GB/day", "Logs/Clickstream"),
    ("External / 3rd Party", "source",      95, "95 GB/day",  "External/3rd Party"),
    ("Databases",            "source",     235, "235 GB/day", "Databases"),
    ("Batch Ingestion",      "ingestion",  310, "Spark / ADF",     None),
    ("Stream Ingestion",     "ingestion", 1015, "Kafka / EventHub", None),
    ("CDC Connector",        "ingestion",  235, "Debezium",        None),
    ("Raw IoT Events",       "bronze",     450, "450 GB",  None),
    ("Raw Transactions",     "bronze",     300, "300 GB",  None),
    ("Raw Log Data",         "bronze",     530, "530 GB",  None),
    ("Raw External Data",    "bronze",     130, "130 GB",  None),
    ("Raw DB Snapshots",     "bronze",     185, "185 GB",  None),
    ("Cleaned IoT Metrics",  "silver",     180, "180 GB",  None),
    ("Unified Customer 360", "silver",      45, "45 GB",   None),
    ("Sessionized Clicks",   "silver",      90, "90 GB",   None),
    ("Enriched Transactions","silver",     110, "110 GB",  None),
    ("Normalized Market",    "silver",      20, "20 GB",   None),
    ("Revenue Aggregates",   "gold",         8, "8 GB",    None),
    ("Customer LTV Scores",  "gold",         3, "3 GB",    None),
    ("Anomaly Detection",    "gold",        12, "12 GB",   None),
    ("Product Perf KPIs",    "gold",         5, "5 GB",    None),
    ("Marketing Attribution","gold",         4, "4 GB",    None),
    ("Executive Dashboards", "consumption",  0, "BI",      None),
    ("Ad-hoc SQL Analytics", "consumption",  0, "BI",      None),
    ("ML Training",          "consumption",  0, "ML",      None),
    ("ML Serving",           "consumption",  0, "ML",      None),
    ("Data API Services",    "consumption",  0, "API",     None),
    ("Reverse ETL",          "consumption",  0, "Rev ETL", None),
]

# ============================================================
# LINK DATA
# ============================================================
links = [
    (0, 6, 450), (1, 5, 250), (2, 6, 530), (3, 5, 60), (3, 6, 35), (4, 7, 235),
    (6, 8, 450), (6, 10, 530), (5, 9, 300), (5, 11, 95), (7, 12, 185), (6, 11, 35),
    (8, 13, 180), (9, 16, 110), (10, 15, 90), (9, 14, 25), (12, 14, 20), (11, 17, 20),
    (16, 18, 8), (14, 19, 3), (13, 20, 12), (16, 21, 5), (15, 22, 4),
    (18, 23, 4), (18, 24, 4), (21, 23, 2.5), (21, 27, 2.5),
    (19, 23, 1), (19, 25, 1), (19, 28, 1),
    (22, 24, 2), (22, 28, 2), (20, 25, 6), (20, 26, 6),
]

# ============================================================
# LAYOUT
# ============================================================
FIG_W, FIG_H = 38, 28
DPI = 110

FLOW_TOP = 23.5
FLOW_BOTTOM = 9.0
FLOW_LEFT = 2.5
FLOW_RIGHT = 35.5

LAYER_NAMES = ["SOURCE", "INGESTION", "BRONZE", "SILVER", "GOLD", "CONSUMPTION"]
LAYER_KEYS = ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]
NUM_LAYERS = 6

COL_X = np.linspace(FLOW_LEFT + 1.5, FLOW_RIGHT - 1.5, NUM_LAYERS)
NODE_W = 1.15

POWER = 0.45
MAX_VOL = 1015
MAX_NODE_H = 9.0
MIN_NODE_H = 0.95
NODE_PAD = 0.22

PANEL_TOP = 8.0
PANEL_BOT = 0.3

# ============================================================
# COMPUTE VOLUMES & POSITIONS
# ============================================================
node_vol_in = [0.0] * len(nodes)
node_vol_out = [0.0] * len(nodes)
for s, t, v in links:
    node_vol_out[s] += v
    node_vol_in[t] += v

node_effective_vol = []
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    if layer == 'consumption':
        node_effective_vol.append(max(node_vol_in[i], 7.5))
    else:
        node_effective_vol.append(max(node_vol_in[i], node_vol_out[i], vol, 1))

node_heights = [max(MAX_NODE_H * (ev / MAX_VOL) ** POWER, MIN_NODE_H) for ev in node_effective_vol]

layer_nodes = {k: [] for k in LAYER_KEYS}
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    layer_nodes[layer].append(i)

node_y_center = [0.0] * len(nodes)
for layer_key in LAYER_KEYS:
    idxs = layer_nodes[layer_key]
    total_h = sum(node_heights[i] for i in idxs) + NODE_PAD * (len(idxs) - 1)
    y_cursor = FLOW_TOP - (FLOW_TOP - FLOW_BOTTOM - total_h) / 2
    for i in idxs:
        node_y_center[i] = y_cursor - node_heights[i] / 2
        y_cursor -= node_heights[i] + NODE_PAD

# ============================================================
# TRACE SOURCE COLORS
# ============================================================
def trace_source_color(nidx, depth=0):
    if depth > 10:
        return LAYER_COLORS[nodes[nidx][1]]
    if nodes[nidx][1] == 'source' and nodes[nidx][4]:
        return SRC_COLORS.get(nodes[nidx][4], LAYER_COLORS['source'])
    incoming = [(s, v) for s, t, v in links if t == nidx]
    if not incoming:
        return LAYER_COLORS[nodes[nidx][1]]
    return trace_source_color(max(incoming, key=lambda x: x[1])[0], depth + 1)

node_flow_color = [trace_source_color(i) for i in range(len(nodes))]

# ============================================================
# FIGURE
# ============================================================
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H), dpi=DPI, facecolor='white')
ax = fig.add_axes([0, PANEL_TOP / FIG_H, 1, 1 - PANEL_TOP / FIG_H])
ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_W)
ax.set_ylim(FLOW_BOTTOM - 2.0, FLOW_TOP + 4.5)
ax.axis('off')

# ============================================================
# LAYER BACKGROUND COLUMNS
# ============================================================
col_half_w = (COL_X[1] - COL_X[0]) / 2 + 0.1
for i, lkey in enumerate(LAYER_KEYS):
    bg_rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (COL_X[i] - col_half_w, FLOW_BOTTOM - 0.3),
        2 * col_half_w, FLOW_TOP - FLOW_BOTTOM + 0.6,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.15",
        facecolor=LAYER_BG[lkey], edgecolor='none', alpha=0.5, zorder=0
    )
    ax.add_patch(bg_rect)

# ============================================================
# TITLE
# ============================================================
ax.text(FIG_W / 2, FLOW_TOP + 3.8,
        "Data Lakehouse Architecture",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=26, fontweight='bold', color='#0F172A')
ax.text(FIG_W / 2, FLOW_TOP + 2.8,
        "End-to-End Pipeline & Data Flow  ·  Medallion Architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold)  ·  Governance Overlay",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12, color='#475569')

# ============================================================
# LAYER HEADERS
# ============================================================
for i, (lname, lkey) in enumerate(zip(LAYER_NAMES, LAYER_KEYS)):
    x = COL_X[i]
    c = LAYER_COLORS[lkey]
    lc = LAYER_LIGHT[lkey]
    ax.text(x, FLOW_TOP + 1.6, lname, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color=c,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.35', facecolor=lc,
                      edgecolor=c, linewidth=2.5, alpha=0.9))

# ============================================================
# CROSS-LAYER GOVERNANCE STRIP
# ============================================================
gov_x = FLOW_RIGHT + 0.8
# Draw a red vertical band
gov_rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
    (gov_x - 0.25, FLOW_BOTTOM - 0.3), 0.5, FLOW_TOP - FLOW_BOTTOM + 0.6,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
    facecolor='#FEE2E2', edgecolor='#DC2626', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.5, zorder=0
)
ax.add_patch(gov_rect)
ax.text(gov_x, FLOW_TOP + 1.6, "GOV", ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='#DC2626',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='#FEE2E2',
                  edgecolor='#DC2626', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.9))

# Small governance markers at each layer
gov_marks = {
    'ingestion': ('Schema Val.', 'Quality Gate'),
    'bronze': ('Audit Log', 'PII Detect'),
    'silver': ('Encryption', 'Lineage', 'Row Sec.'),
    'gold': ('RBAC', 'Certification', 'Tracking'),
    'consumption': ('Auth', 'Rate Limit'),
}
for lkey, marks in gov_marks.items():
    col_idx = LAYER_KEYS.index(lkey)
    idxs = layer_nodes[lkey]
    y_top = node_y_center[idxs[0]] + node_heights[idxs[0]] / 2
    y_bot = node_y_center[idxs[-1]] - node_heights[idxs[-1]] / 2
    y_mid = (y_top + y_bot) / 2
    # Small colored dots on the governance strip
    ax.plot(gov_x, y_mid, 'o', color='#DC2626', markersize=4, alpha=0.6, zorder=1)
    ax.text(gov_x + 0.35, y_mid, '\n'.join(marks), ha='left', va='center',
            fontsize=5.5, color='#B91C1C', alpha=0.7, zorder=1, linespacing=1.3)

# ============================================================
# DRAW FLOW LINES
# ============================================================
def bezier_pts(p0, p1, n=50):
    x0, y0 = p0
    x1, y1 = p1
    xm = (x0 + x1) / 2
    t = np.linspace(0, 1, n)
    x = (1-t)**3*x0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t*xm + 3*(1-t)*t**2*xm + t**3*x1
    y = (1-t)**3*y0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t*y0 + 3*(1-t)*t**2*y1 + t**3*y1
    return x, y

sorted_links = sorted(links, key=lambda l: l[2])

for s, t, v in sorted_links:
    src_layer = nodes[s][1]
    tgt_layer = nodes[t][1]
    x_src = COL_X[LAYER_KEYS.index(src_layer)] + NODE_W / 2 + 0.02
    x_tgt = COL_X[LAYER_KEYS.index(tgt_layer)] - NODE_W / 2 - 0.02
    y_src = node_y_center[s]
    y_tgt = node_y_center[t]

    lw = 0.5 + 8.0 * (v / MAX_VOL) ** 0.45
    fc = node_flow_color[s]

    bx, by = bezier_pts((x_src, y_src), (x_tgt, y_tgt), n=50)
    ax.plot(bx, by, color=fc, linewidth=lw, alpha=0.30,
            solid_capstyle='round', zorder=1)

    # Arrowhead
    dx = bx[-1] - bx[-4]
    dy = by[-1] - by[-4]
    norm = max(math.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2), 0.01)
    arr_len = 0.22
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x_tgt + 0.02, y_tgt),
                xytext=(x_tgt + 0.02 - arr_len * dx / norm,
                        y_tgt - arr_len * dy / norm),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', color=fc,
                                lw=max(lw * 0.4, 0.8), mutation_scale=8),
                zorder=2)

# ============================================================
# DRAW NODES
# ============================================================
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    col_idx = LAYER_KEYS.index(layer)
    x = COL_X[col_idx]
    yc = node_y_center[i]
    h = node_heights[i]

    if layer == 'source' and cat:
        edge_c = SRC_COLORS.get(cat, LAYER_COLORS[layer])
        fill_c = SRC_LIGHT.get(cat, LAYER_LIGHT[layer])
    else:
        edge_c = LAYER_COLORS[layer]
        fill_c = LAYER_LIGHT[layer]

    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - NODE_W / 2, yc - h / 2), NODE_W, h,
        boxstyle=mpatches.BoxStyle("Round", pad=0.07),
        facecolor=fill_c, edgecolor=edge_c, linewidth=2.5, zorder=5
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    # Text
    if h >= 1.3:
        ax.text(x, yc + 0.15, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color='#1E293B', zorder=6)
        if detail:
            ax.text(x, yc - 0.28, detail, ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=7, color='#475569', zorder=6, style='italic')
    elif h >= 0.9:
        ax.text(x, yc + 0.06, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', color='#1E293B', zorder=6)
        ax.text(x, yc - 0.2, detail, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=6, color='#475569', zorder=6, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(x, yc, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold', color='#1E293B', zorder=6,
                clip_on=True)

# ============================================================
# CONSUMPTION VOLUME LABELS
# ============================================================
for i, (label, layer, vol, detail, cat) in enumerate(nodes):
    if layer == 'consumption':
        x = COL_X[LAYER_KEYS.index(layer)] + NODE_W / 2 + 0.1
        y = node_y_center[i]
        iv = sum(v for s, t, v in links if t == i)
        if iv > 0:
            ax.text(x, y, f" ← {iv:.0f} GB", ha='left', va='center',
                    fontsize=6.5, color='#64748B', zorder=7)

# ============================================================
# VOLUME REDUCTION SUMMARY
# ============================================================
total_src = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'source')
total_brz = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'bronze')
total_slv = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'silver')
total_gld = sum(n[2] for n in nodes if n[1] == 'gold')
pct = (1 - total_gld / total_src) * 100

ax.text(FIG_W / 2, FLOW_BOTTOM - 0.8,
        f"Daily Volume:  {total_src:,} GB (Source)  →  {total_brz:,} GB (Bronze)  →  "
        f"{total_slv:,} GB (Silver)  →  {total_gld:,} GB (Gold)   ·   "
        f"{pct:.1f}% reduction from raw to refined",
        ha='center', va='top', fontsize=10.5, color='#334155',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor='#F1F5F9',
                  edgecolor='#94A3B8', linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.9))

# ============================================================
# SOURCE CATEGORY LEGEND
# ============================================================
leg_x = FLOW_LEFT + 0.5
leg_y = FLOW_BOTTOM - 1.7
ax.text(leg_x, leg_y, "Source Categories:", fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color='#475569')
for ci, (cat_name, cat_color) in enumerate(SRC_COLORS.items()):
    xoff = leg_x + ci * 3.0
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (xoff, leg_y - 0.55), 0.35, 0.35,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.03", facecolor=SRC_LIGHT[cat_name],
        edgecolor=cat_color, linewidth=1.5, zorder=5))
    ax.text(xoff + 0.45, leg_y - 0.38, cat_name, fontsize=7, color='#334155', va='center')

# Line width legend
lw_x = leg_x + 16.0
ax.text(lw_x, leg_y, "Flow Width = Volume:", fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color='#475569')
for li, (lv, ll) in enumerate([(530, "530 GB"), (90, "90 GB"), (8, "8 GB")]):
    ly = leg_y - 0.35 - li * 0.4
    lw = 0.5 + 8.0 * (lv / MAX_VOL) ** 0.45
    ax.plot([lw_x, lw_x + 1.2], [ly, ly], color='#64748B', linewidth=lw, alpha=0.5)
    ax.text(lw_x + 1.4, ly, ll, fontsize=7, color='#475569', va='center')

# ============================================================
# TRANSFORMATION PANEL (bottom-left)
# ============================================================
ax_t = fig.add_axes([1.5 / FIG_W, PANEL_BOT / FIG_H,
                      15.0 / FIG_W, (PANEL_TOP - PANEL_BOT - 0.3) / FIG_H])
ax_t.set_facecolor('#FAFBFC')

trans_data = [
    ('Bronze', 'Schema-on-Read', 10, 'low', LAYER_COLORS['bronze']),
    ('Bronze', 'Deduplication', 5, 'low', LAYER_COLORS['bronze']),
    ('Bronze', 'Timestamp Norm.', 8, 'low', LAYER_COLORS['bronze']),
    ('Silver', 'Null/Outlier Clean', 12, 'medium', LAYER_COLORS['silver']),
    ('Silver', 'SCD2 Conformance', 5, 'high', LAYER_COLORS['silver']),
    ('Silver', 'Join / Enrichment', 8, 'high', LAYER_COLORS['silver']),
    ('Silver', 'Sessionization', 3, 'high', LAYER_COLORS['silver']),
    ('Silver', 'PII Masking', 6, 'medium', LAYER_COLORS['silver']),
    ('Gold', 'Aggregation / Roll-up', 10, 'medium', LAYER_COLORS['gold']),
    ('Gold', 'Feature Engineering', 7, 'high', LAYER_COLORS['gold']),
    ('Gold', 'Business Logic / KPI', 8, 'high', LAYER_COLORS['gold']),
    ('Gold', 'Materialized Views', 5, 'medium', LAYER_COLORS['gold']),
]

comp_fill = {'low': '#BBF7D0', 'medium': '#FEF08A', 'high': '#FECACA'}
comp_edge = {'low': '#16A34A', 'medium': '#CA8A04', 'high': '#DC2626'}

y_pos = list(range(len(trans_data)))
labels_t = [f"{d[0]}: {d[1]}" for d in trans_data]
widths = [d[2] for d in trans_data]
fills = [comp_fill[d[3]] for d in trans_data]
edges = [comp_edge[d[3]] for d in trans_data]

ax_t.barh(y_pos, widths, color=fills, edgecolor=edges,
           linewidth=1.3, height=0.65, zorder=3)

for yi, w in zip(y_pos, widths):
    ax_t.text(w + 0.3, yi, str(w), va='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#334155', fontweight='bold')

ax_t.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax_t.set_yticklabels(labels_t, fontsize=7.5, color='#334155')
ax_t.invert_yaxis()
ax_t.set_xlabel('Transformation Count', fontsize=8.5, color='#475569')
ax_t.set_title('Transformation Stages by Medallion Layer',
               fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#0F172A', pad=10)

ax_t.axhline(2.5, color='#CBD5E1', lw=0.8, ls='--', zorder=2)
ax_t.axhline(7.5, color='#CBD5E1', lw=0.8, ls='--', zorder=2)

from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_patches = [
    Patch(facecolor=comp_fill['low'], edgecolor=comp_edge['low'], label='Low'),
    Patch(facecolor=comp_fill['medium'], edgecolor=comp_edge['medium'], label='Medium'),

]
ax_t.legend(handles=legend_patches, title='Complexity', loc='lower right',

ax_t.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_t.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_t.set_xlim(0, max(widths) + 4)
ax_t.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=7.5)

# Layer totals
brz_t = sum(d[2] for d in trans_data if d[0] == 'Bronze')
slv_t = sum(d[2] for d in trans_data if d[0] == 'Silver')

ax_t.text(max(widths) + 3, 5, f'Total: {slv_t}', fontsize=7, color=LAYER_COLORS['silver'], fontweight='bold', va='center')
ax_t.text(max(widths) + 3, 10.5, f'Total: {gld_t}', fontsize=7, color=LAYER_COLORS['gold'], fontweight='bold', va='center')

ax_g.set_ylim(0, 1)

ax_g.plot([0.02, 0.98], [0.895, 0.895], color='#CBD5E1', linewidth=0.8,
          transform=ax_g.transAxes, clip_on=False)

gov_data = [
    ('Ingestion', LAYER_COLORS['ingestion'], [
        ('Schema Validation', 'Schema Registry', 'Automated'),
        ('Data Quality Gate', 'Great Expectations', 'Automated'),

for idx, (ename, ecolor) in enumerate(enf_colors.items()):
